jobposting.description: If you want frontier tooling and tech in your daily work, real ownership of what you build, and a domain with real impact – read on. If you've stopped continuously learning, or you'd rather spend weeks deep inside one narrow problem, this isn't the place.Key factsRole: mid-level engineer working end-to-end on data/AI systems for healthcare – from classical ML to LLM-based agents at model level, through handling the data pipelines, cloud, and integrations that make them run in production.Team: work is fully remote, but most of the team is in Poland, in the Poznań area. We meet in person during team retreats on a roughly quarterly basis.Who you work with: a small, experienced technical team, with 20+ healthcare data/AI projects delivered, our internal medical advisors, and clients directly.Contract: B2B or mandate, flexible hours.Languages: Fluent English and Polish – written and spoken. Most of the team and part of our clients work in Polish, so fluent Polish is a hard requirement. We can make rare exceptions here for exceptional profiles – if you believe that's you, say why in one line in your application.What we do – and why healthcareWe're datarabbit.ai – data and AI partner for healthcare and life sciences organizations. We design and deliver production-grade data and AI systems for medical devices, hospitals, life sciences, and pharma across the EU and US.Healthcare AI is one of the toughest technical niches today. Compliance requirements, integrations with 'heavy' legacy systems, end users for whom a PoC built on 'we'll figure it out later' is unacceptable. Many companies steer clear of this space entirely.We don't. We build data platforms processing terabytes of medical data for research. Voicebots talking to patients after surgery. Systems automating analysis and filling of medical documentation. AI agents for enterprise healthcare. All production-grade, compliant, secure, end-to-end – and we've been at it since before AI was fashionable.Some of what that looked like in practice:NLP/LLM documentation automation pipelines that helped cut the staff time required by ~60% – from ~1.5 hours to under 30 minutes per patient;developing frontier imaging models doing aneurysm detection from brain imaging at human-level sensitivity for a neurology startup;a cloud-agnostic MLOps platform that let a genomics research team run 40% more experiments in the same time.Where you fit – what a day may actually look likeMorning – design. The hospital documentation automation system – that fills forms from clinical notes so that humans don’t have to – needs to cover a new type of handwritten document. You sketch where it fits, decide what the extraction step owns and what stays in the form logic.Then the one meeting of today: a 30-minute sync with the project team. You walk them through the design, they poke at it, and the physician on the team settles which fields the model may leave empty and which it must never guess.Midday – implementation. You build the extraction step. The boilerplate comes out of agentic coding tools, supported by our internal skills and patterns – but the judgment calls are ultimately yours.Late afternoon (you took a couple of hours off in the middle of the day for something personal, which is fine here) – you check your changes after deployment to the dev environment. There was a small formatting issue, which you traced in the logs, fixed in the code, and added a regression test for. If needed, the client could see the new feature the same day.You end the day with the PR submitted and a short write-up in the project channel – if it's reusable, it goes to the shared component library. You also check up updates from another project team in the Slack channel – looks like they'll have something good to show at this week's knowledge sharing session.Over timeOwnership grows, and so does what you know. In the first months you own a whole component inside a project and pick up the domain – how hospitals actually work, what compliance means for tech in practice.Around six months you're the engineer a project lead hands a whole stream to, with a client-facing call or two and the first architecture decisions that are yours. After a year you own a project stream with someone more junior alongside, or a piece of internal IP – and the cloud, MLOps or domain certifications you collect on the way are funded and rewarded. If you're heading toward leading, say so. We set goals together every quarter, and when you're stuck, there's always someone to ask.What we require3+ years in software and ML / AI engineeringProblem-solving mindset, not just task execution. If your approach is 'I didn't go into IT to talk with people' – this isn't the place. We dig into the client's business and often ask better questions than they do themselves.AI power-user mindset. You actively use LLMs, agents, and frontier tooling to automate your own work. You follow the industry regularly, not on a quarterly basis. AI-first isn't a buzzword for us – it's how we work daily.Genuine interest in healthcare. No prior healthcare experience required (we'll help you ramp up the domain) – but you need to be authentically excited about building tech that affects how people are cared for. If your 'interest' stops at 'AI is cool' – we're probably not the right fit.Full-stack engineering mindset – Python/AI is the core, but you're fine working with infra, data pipelines, cloud, and surrounding systems when the project demands.Nice to haveKnowledge of healthcare domain: specific systems, standards, and formats (e.g. HL7/FHIR, DICOM, Nextflow, etc.)Experience with classical ML, deep learning frameworks, and modern LLM stackExperience with data engineering and workflow orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, etc.)Strong cloud skills (AWS preferred, Azure/GCP welcome)Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in CS, Biomedical Engineering, ECE, or related fieldA GitHub or portfolio – not required, but if you maintain one, it's a definite plus and we'll go through itWhat you getReal impact – production systems used by medical clients, actually affecting patients, public health, and the pace of research.Frontier mindset – we adopt new models and tools as soon as they make sense. We don't spend quarters getting them approved, like large organizations do.Swiss army knife mode – models/AI is one thing, but we work end-to-end: ML, infra, data, client, user-facing apps. For some this is a killer, for others the best job they've had. If you love spending weeks deep in one narrow problem – this isn't us.Direct influence on projects and the company's direction – you won't be another cog in the machine.Fully remote with flexible hours – need to pick up your kid, hit a doctor's appointment, work better in the evenings? No problem.Dedicated training budget and learning opportunities – weekly sessions where the team shares what it's learned; quarterly goal reviews with certifications funded and rewarded; research topics and publications; hackathons participation; and more;How the hiring process looks:CV pre-selection by the engineering team, then:Intro call – 5-10 min: background, some additional details about the company and role, your questions.A short take-home coding task – a simple one, up to an hour or so max to complete – but you will have a week to comfortably fit it into your schedule.A technical interview with two of our engineers.A conversation with the CEO.After the pre-selection, the rest of the process usually takes up to ~2 weeks

jobposting.description: We are looking for an Application Security Engineer (F/M) to join our engineering team and help us build security into the software development lifecycle. This role is an opportunity to move beyond traditional vulnerability management and drive a proactive approach to application security. You will work closely with software engineers, architects, DevOps and security teams to automate security controls, integrate security into CI/CD pipelines, improve secure development practices and help teams build secure-by-design applications.Your responsibilities:Own and continuously improve the application security posture of internally developed solutions, ensuring security is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).Monitor, assess, prioritise, and manage application security vulnerabilities identified through penetration testing, SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, bug bounty programmes, and other security assessment activities, ensuring remediation within agreed SLAs.Triage security findings to determine business risk, remediation requirements, and false positives, providing clear technical justification for all decisions.Design, recommend and implement long-term, scalable security controls and automation to reduce recurring vulnerabilities, minimise manual intervention, and improve remediation efficiency across development teams.Drive a shift-left security approach by integrating automated security testing, policy enforcement, and secure development practices into CI/CD pipelines and engineering workflows.Identify recurring vulnerability patterns and implement preventative controls, secure frameworks, coding standards, and developer guardrails that eliminate classes of vulnerabilities at source.Serve as the primary liaison with external penetration testing providers, ensuring security assessments are completed in a timely manner and findings are actionable, risk-based, and aligned with business priorities.Partner with Group Security teams to maintain a single source of truth for vulnerabilities, consult, agree risk ratings, and resolve disputes relating to remediation requirements or false-positive findings.Provide expert guidance on securing modern web applications, APIs, authentication mechanisms, and cloud-native architectures, with particular focus on .NET and Angular solutions.Act as the Application Security subject matter expert for the Solution Delivery organisation, promoting secure design principles and security-by-default practices across all stages of solution delivery.Maintain and enhance secure development standards, application security policies, and security engineering processes in line with OWASP, NIST, and industry best practices.Proactively monitor emerging threats, OWASP Top 10 trends, attack techniques, and security tooling innovations, ensuring the organisation remains ahead of evolving application security risks.Deliver security awareness and secure coding guidance to developers, technical leads, architects, and delivery teams to improve organisational security maturity.Update on application security posture, vulnerability trends, remediation performance, and risk reduction initiatives to governance forums and steering groups, providing data-driven insights and recommendations.Our requirements:Strong practical knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and common web application attack vectors.Deep understanding of securing modern web applications, REST APIs, authentication and authorisation mechanisms (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT).Experience implementing and managing SAST, DAST, SCA, API security and penetration testing programmes.Experience automating security controls within CI/CD pipelines and software delivery processes.Strong knowledge of secure software engineering practices and secure-by-design principles.Experience with .NET, Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern web application architectures.Ability to identify strategic security improvements rather than focusing solely on vulnerability remediation.Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence development teams, architects, and security functions.Highly motivated, enthusiastic, and capable of working both independently and collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a business-focused approach.Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions and communicate effectively in a fast-paced environment.Demonstrates creativity and resourcefulness in presenting solutions to complex security challenges.What we offer:The opportunity to influence technological solutions and product direction in an international financial organizationAmbitious projects with a high degree of autonomy and responsibilityA stable, long-term assignment with flexible working hours and a hybrid work model

jobposting.description: WHO WE ARE: The Cyber Security team, part of Accenture Security, assists clients in securing hybrid environments and applications at every stage of the software development lifecycle, ensuring that the principles of 'Security by design' and 'Security by default' are followed, thereby integrating security into the DevOps and SDLC process.   THE WORK: Collaborate with design and development teams to embed security principles from the start of the SDLC, fostering innovation and secure growth. Support migration and transformation projects by integrating security into new technology layers and public cloud environments. Design, develop, and manage CI/CD pipelines, automating security steps to improve efficiency and scalability. Automate security tasks within DevOps processes using tools such as Ansible, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, and GitLab, driving continuous improvement. Conduct security assessments of hybrid solutions and assist teams with securing public cloud environments (Azure, GCP, AWS). Secure public cloud and microservices-based environments, ensuring compliance and resilience. Protect AI-driven applications and systems throughout their entire lifecycle - from design and development to deployment. Perform in-depth security reviews of API designs, source code, and deployment processes to identify and mitigate vulnerabilities. Implement advanced API security platforms and real-time monitoring solutions for continuous protection. Conduct comprehensive threat analyses for applications and propose effective mitigation strategies for identified risks. Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing expert guidance on secure design principles and emerging trends in cloud and application security. Support clients in advancing their maturity in DevSecOps and Application Security by applying modern methodologies and AI-driven approaches. Design, develop, and evolve CI/CD environments by integrating security tools such as Snyk, Veracode, Checkmarx, Opentext, WIZ, and Argo CD. Flexible: The work location for this role may include a mix of working remotely, onsite at a client or in an Accenture office - depending on specific project circumstances.With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?Work on projects for international clients, expanding your security skill set. Gain insights and feedback from a diverse team of over 150 cybersecurity experts in Poland and thousands across the world.Thrive in an exciting workplace that values and celebrates diverse perspectives. Contribute to a creative environment where your ideas are welcomed.Engage in creative projects that foster your development as cybersecurity specialist. Access continuous learning through workshops and skill-building initiatives.QualificationsHERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Solid understanding of cybersecurity concepts or strong motivation to deepen expertise, supported by several years of experience in IT or a DevOps-related role.  Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: Azure, GCP, or AWS.  Familiarity with web application security principles, including OWASP Top 10, secure coding practices, and common attack methods (XSS, CSRF, SQL Injection), as well as frameworks such as MITRE.  Basic knowledge of containerization and container orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, OpenShift).  Practical experience with SAST, DAST, and SCA tools and their integration into CI/CD pipelines, along with understanding of authentication, authorization, and session management (SAML, OAuth, SSO).  Knowledge of SSDLC processes, REST API technology, and API Gateway concepts.  Knowledge of application and API security principles, covering secure design, development, and deployment practices.  Foundational knowledge of AI model architectures, memory context, prompt engineering, and integration with external services.  Awareness of AI-related security risks (e.g., prompt injection, data leakage, misuse) and fundamentals of AppSec.  Experience conducting security reviews of API designs, source code, and deployments, and implementing API security platforms and monitoring solutions.  Ability to integrate security into DevOps pipelines and apply SSDLC principles effectively.  Skilled in threat modeling and capable of proposing robust mitigation strategies for identified risks.  Curiosity and adaptability to explore emerging technologies, analyze documentation, and rapidly prototype innovative solutions.  BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE: Good knowledge of one of the selected programming languages: Java, .Net, C#, JavaScript, Go and scripting languages such as Python. Ability to build and integrate solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs) such as Azure OpenAI, LangChain, REST APIs, embeddings, and vector databases. Hands-on experience in creating scripts, prototypes, and micro-applications (preferably in VS Code environment). Practical experience of working with DevSecOps tools from vendors like Snyk, WIZ, IriusRisk, CrowdStrike, Aqua Security, Checkmarx, Opentext, Argo CD etc. Research indicates that some candidates, especially the most diverse ones, may hesitate to apply for positions if they don't meet all requirements. If you believe you possess the necessary skills, even if not meeting every requirement, we wholeheartedly encourage you to submit your application.WHAT WE OFFER:Permanent employment contract.Individual support of a People Lead and a specific path of professional development, as well as the possibility of a session with a Coach.A wide training package (soft, technical, and language training offer, access to the e-learning platforms, Gallup test, GenAI training, possibility of co-financing courses, and certification).Employee Assistance Program - legal, financial, and psychological consultations.Accenture employees eligible for the Employee share purchase plan automatically become eligible for quarterly dividends if they own company shares.Paid employee referral program.Private medical care, life insurance.Access to the Worksmile platform (possibility of using a wide range of products and services, including the Multisport card).WHAT WE BELIEVE:Accenture does not discriminate employment candidates on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, national origin, political beliefs, trade union membership, ethnicity, denomination, sexual orientation or any other basis impermissible under Polish law.All our leaders are committed to building a better, stronger and more durable company for future generations to create positive, long-lasting change. Inclusion and diversity are fundamental to our culture and core values. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative and creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities.Our position as partner to many of the world’s leading businesses, organizations and governments affords us both an extraordinary opportunity and a tremendous responsibility to make a difference. Sustainability is one of our greatest responsibilities, which we embed it into everything we do and for everyone we work with.Clicking apply I hereby express my consent to process my personal data included in my job offer by Accenture Sp. z o.o. or any other entity of the Accenture group for recruitment purposes, and that it is a data controller within the meaning of GDPR. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.About the role:We're hiring a Generalist Engineer, a problem solver, and a passionate person. You will be working on the Marketing AI Team - our goal is to enable AI transformation for the entire marketing organisation in Remitly. We do this by building a foundation layer for other products and tools to use. You'll work across the stack and across domains. This role is for someone who sees a vague problem or a blank roadmap, and thinks “great, my favorite.”You are not a superhero. We don't need one of those. We need someone who's clearly in the superhero origin-story arc, the part of the movie where they're figuring out their powers and only occasionally setting things on fire.You'll make important decisions, mostly on your own based on data and conversations with our partners. We work in a Kanban but we don't follow the methodology strictly. The engineering team is located in Kraków and reports to local Engineering Manager. We are working in hybrid work model, when everyone is expected to be in the office at least 50% of the time, calculated monthly.You will:Own problems end to end - from talking to partners to understand what's actually needed, to shipping and making sure it holds up in production.Make autonomous calls on architecture, tradeoffs, and priorities, then defend them to partners with data instead of vibes.Work directly with people across the business, translating fuzzy requests into end products.Use AI tooling as a genuine force multiplier in your daily work, while maintaining the critical eye to catch when it's making things up with great confidence.Dig into data when decisions need evidence, querying, analyzing, and drawing conclusions that hold up.Grow into the kind of engineer other people quietly hope gets assigned to their project.You have:At least 5 years of engineering experience, ideally the kind that left some scars and good stories.Proficiency in at least one backend language with strong preferences towards Go.Hands-on experience working with data: querying it, wrangling it, and interpreting it.Fluency and real experience working with AI and LLMs, paired with the maturity to be skeptical of them.The independence to run with things solo and the judgment to know when to pull others in.A serious passion for security. Additional onsite attendance may be required based on business needs, and the Company may modify its hybrid-work expectations from time to time. Będziesz samodzielnie prowadzić najbardziej złożone tematy infrastrukturalne, wspierać nas w podejmowaniu kluczowych decyzji technicznych i wraz z poznawaniem organizacji przejmować coraz większą odpowiedzialność za cały obszar DevOps.O roli i obszarze DevOpsW obszarze DevOps współpracują obecnie dwaj Mid DevOps Engineerowie oraz osoba odpowiedzialna za jego prowadzenie. Wraz ze wzrostem liczby i złożoności projektów potrzebujemy kolejnej osoby z doświadczeniem seniorskim, która spojrzy na rozwiązania nie tylko przez pryzmat tego, czy działają, ale również ich bezpieczeństwa, stabilności, kosztów i możliwości dalszego utrzymania.Docelowo będziesz wyznaczać techniczny kierunek rozwoju obszaru, dbać o spójność standardów, koordynować najważniejsze tematy oraz mieć wpływ na wybór technologii, narzędzi i dostawców chmurowych.Pierwsze dwa miesiące przeznaczymy na poznanie projektów, środowisk, dokumentacji, wcześniejszych decyzji i najważniejszych ryzyk. W tym czasie zaczniesz również samodzielnie prowadzić wybrane tematy techniczne.W pierwszym półroczu wśród ważnych tematów znajdą się m.in. automatyzacja procesów związanych z ISO 27001, rozwój zabezpieczeń Cloudflare WAF, dalsza standaryzacja i konteneryzacja wybranych środowisk oraz ocena zasadności planowanych zmian i migracji infrastruktury.W pierwszych dwóch miesiącach preferujemy realizowanie współpracy z naszego biura w Łodzi przez 4 dni w tygodniu. Zależy nam na stacjonarnej części wdrożenia, ponieważ będzie to czas poznawania projektów, infrastruktury, dotychczasowych decyzji technicznych, zespołu oraz sposobu współpracy. Konkretne dni obecności będziemy ustalać wspólnie i z wyprzedzeniem.Jeżeli nie możesz być w Łodzi w takim wymiarze, ale masz możliwość regularnej współpracy z naszego biura przez mniejszą liczbę dni, a pozostałą część usług możesz realizować zdalnie, również zachęcamy Cię do aplikowania. Daj nam znać, jaką obecność w Łodzi możesz zadeklarować, to wspólnie sprawdzimy, czy możemy odpowiednio zaplanować wdrożenie.Po pierwszych dwóch miesiącach obecność w Łodzi będzie rzadsza i dopasowana do uzgodnionych potrzeb projektów oraz obszaru DevOps. Czym będziesz się zajmować?Projektowaniem, rozwijaniem i utrzymywaniem infrastruktury projektów klienckich i wewnętrznych.Automatyzacją procesów administracyjnych i wdrożeniowych oraz rozwijaniem Infrastructure as Code.Budowaniem i optymalizowaniem pipeline’ów CI/CD.Pracą z Ubuntu, Dockerem, Docker Swarm, Kubernetes, DigitalOcean i Cloudflare. Obecnie zarządzamy w Cloudflare ponad 300 hostami.Konfiguracją monitoringu, logowania i alertowania oraz diagnozowaniem incydentów produkcyjnych.Dbaniem o bezpieczeństwo, backupy, certyfikaty, dostępność i stabilność usług.Analizowaniem kosztów infrastruktury i rekomendowaniem usprawnień.Rozwijaniem standardów technicznych i koordynowaniem tematów obejmujących kilka projektów lub zespołów.Konsultowaniem rozwiązań z pozostałymi inżynierami DevOps, developerami, QA, Project Managerami i klientami.Dokumentowaniem rozwiązań, dbaniem o przepływ wiedzy oraz komunikowaniem ryzyk i rekomendacji.Udziałem w dyżurach on-call po zakończeniu wdrożenia.Jakiego doświadczenia szukamy?Bardzo dobrej znajomości systemów Linux/Unix i doświadczenia w administracji środowiskami produkcyjnymi.Dobrej znajomości Dockera oraz doświadczenia z Docker Swarm lub Kubernetes.Bardzo dobrej znajomości procesów CI/CD, najlepiej GitLab CI.Umiejętności automatyzowania zadań z wykorzystaniem Ansible, Terraform, Bash lub Pythona.Praktycznej znajomości co najmniej jednej chmury, np. DigitalOcean, GCP, AWS, Azure lub Akamai Linode.Znajomości zagadnień sieciowych, takich jak TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, proxy, load balancing i firewalls.Doświadczenia z monitoringiem, logowaniem, alertowaniem i rozwiązywaniem incydentów produkcyjnych.Znajomości dobrych praktyk dotyczących bezpieczeństwa, backupów, certyfikatów, IAM i hardeningu.Znajomości języka polskiego i angielskiego na poziomie umożliwiającym swobodną komunikację projektową.Nie oczekujemy eksperckiej znajomości każdego narzędzia i każdej chmury z tej listy. Ważniejsze jest dla nas rozumienie systemów, umiejętność diagnozowania problemów i podejmowania świadomych decyzji.Dobrze odnajdziesz się w tej roli, jeśli:samodzielnie prowadzisz złożone tematy i bierzesz odpowiedzialność za ich realizację,potrafisz patrzeć na rozwiązania szerzej, uwzględniając bezpieczeństwo, stabilność, koszty i dalsze utrzymanie,podejmujesz świadome decyzje techniczne i potrafisz jasno wyjaśnić ich uzasadnienie,potrafisz porządkować tematy, uzgadniać priorytety i doprowadzać wspólne ustalenia do realizacji,dobrze współpracujesz z innymi inżynierami, dzielisz się wiedzą i przekazujesz konstruktywny feedback,potrafisz komunikować ryzyka i rekomendacje osobom o różnym poziomie wiedzy technicznej,interesujesz się rozwojem AI i chcesz pogłębiać wiedzę dotyczącą infrastruktury, MLOps, bezpieczeństwa i kosztów rozwiązań AI.Ta rola może nie być dla Ciebie, jeśli szukasz wyłącznie indywidualnej roli eksperckiej, w której odpowiadasz jedynie za własne zadania i nie chcesz angażować się w rozwijanie standardów, konsultowanie rozwiązań ani koordynowanie tematów.Dodatkowym atutem będzie:doświadczenie w projektowaniu środowisk High Availability lub architektury multi-cloud,doświadczenie w optymalizacji kosztów infrastruktury,udział w audytach bezpieczeństwa,praktyczna wiedza z obszaru MLOps lub wdrażania rozwiązań AI,doświadczenie w mentoringu lub technicznym wspieraniu mniej doświadczonych osób,znajomość architektury aplikacji webowych, migracji baz danych, workerów i procesów wykonywanych cyklicznie.Dyżury on-callDyżury odbywają się w cyklach tygodniowych, od poniedziałku od godziny 9:00 do kolejnego poniedziałku do godziny 9:00. Monitoring i analiza anomalii odbywają się z wykorzystaniem Better Stack, a alertowanie przez PagerDuty.Do rotacji dołączysz po okresie wdrożenia. Szczegóły dotyczące częstotliwości, oczekiwanego czasu reakcji i sposobu rozliczania przedstawimy podczas pierwszego spotkania, aby były jasne przed podjęciem decyzji o kontynuowaniu procesu.O goodylabsgoodylabs to firma technologiczna z Łodzi. Łączymy design, development i doradztwo cyfrowe, tworząc rozwiązania dla klientów z różnych branż, od fintechu i e-commerce po edukację, wellbeing i projekty wykorzystujące AI.W pracy kierujemy się szczerością, ciekawością, odpowiedzialnością i skutecznością. Zależy nam na bezpośredniej komunikacji, samodzielności i rozwiązaniach, które mają sens techniczny oraz biznesowy.Nasze pet-friendly biuro znajduje się w Starej Drukarni przy ul. Gdańskiej 130 w Łodzi.Jak wygląda proces rekrutacji?Proces chcemy zamknąć w ciągu około 4 tygodni. Planujemy trzy spotkania:Rozmowa online z Patrycją z People & Culture, około 45 minut. Pojawią się również krótkie pytania wstępnie weryfikujące doświadczenie techniczne.Pogłębiona rozmowa techniczna, około 60-90 minut.Skupimy się na Twoich doświadczeniach, sposobie analizowania problemów i podejmowania decyzji technicznych.Spotkanie w naszym biurze w Łodzi, około 45-60 minut. Porozmawiamy o wzajemnych oczekiwaniach, docelowym zakresie odpowiedzialności i warunkach rozpoczęcia współpracy.Nie planujemy dodatkowego zadania domowego. Przed każdym spotkaniem otrzymasz informację o jego uczestnikach, przewidywanym czasie i zakresie rozmowy.Po ostatnim spotkaniu, jeśli obie strony będą zainteresowane kontynuowaniem procesu, poprosimy Cię o wskazanie jednej lub dwóch osób, które mogą udzielić Ci referencji. Skontaktujemy się z nimi wyłącznie za Twoją wiedzą i po wcześniejszym uzgodnieniu tego z Tobą.Po zakończeniu procesu wrócimy do Ciebie z decyzją w ciągu maksymalnie 7 dni roboczych. Niezależnie od wyniku nie zostawimy Cię bez odpowiedzi.Chcesz z nami porozmawiać?Nie wymagamy listu motywacyjnego ani dodatkowych materiałów. Prześlij CV lub link do aktualnego profilu zawodowego.Jeśli szukasz roli, w której możesz łączyć pracę techniczną z realnym wpływem na standardy i dalszy rozwój obszaru DevOps, daj nam się poznać.

jobposting.description: Job DescriptionYou are an experienced data domain owner or data asset manager who thrives at the intersection of data governance, business partnership, and hands-on analytics. You know how to bring order to complex, multi-source data ecosystems — and you care deeply about data quality and trust.In this role, you will own the end-to-end data stewardship, governance, and management of the Employee Care data ecosystem — from defining how data is sourced and structured, to ensuring it is trusted, well-defined, and ready for downstream analytics and reporting.You will be embedded across three connected teams: the Employee Care D&A Product team, the Employee Care Service team, and the Employee Insights Program — giving you both strategic visibility and operational grounding.This is a hands-on leadership role. You will move fluidly between deep data analysis, governance design, business partnership, and data asset design — and you will be a key voice in shaping how Employee Care data creates business value.Why This Role MattersThe Employee Care Data & Analytics portfolio is rapidly expanding. Its ambition goes beyond improving day-to-day support operations — it aims to transform the employee experience, elevate service quality across all People Services, and turn employee needs signals into actionable insights that unlock superior service delivery across Self-Serve, L1, L2+, HR, and IT support tiers.You will be a foundational enabler of that ambition.What You Will Do1. Own Source Data Stewardship & GovernanceYou will be the primary data steward for Employee Care source systems — principally ServiceNow (ticket data) and AskEve/Rezolve (chat and self-serve interaction data). You will map tables and fields to analytics needs, assess data sufficiency and completeness, and work with platform owners to close identified data gaps. You will ensure data at the source is trusted and fit for downstream use.2. Lead Source Data Change ManagementYou will establish and own a formal change management process covering schema changes, field additions, value list updates, and workflow changes across in-scope data systems. This includes impact assessments, structured communication, sign-off processes, post-implementation validation, and maintaining regression and No-Negative-Impact Testing (NNIT) protocols — so that changes never silently break downstream analytics.3. Shape the Data Strategy for Employee CareWorking closely with the Employee Care D&A Product Owner, you will help define a forward-looking data asset strategy — what data assets are needed, how they should be structured and prioritized, and how they should evolve. You will bring a strategic data perspective into planning and roadmap discussions.4. Build Business Partnership Around Definitions & KPIsYou will partner with HR, IT, and Support Operations stakeholders to align on business nomenclature and KPI definitions — driving consensus so that everyone is working from the same shared understanding of key metrics and terms. You will maintain a living business glossary for the Employee Care domain.5. Define and Monitor Data QualityYou will deep-dive into source data to assess quality, completeness, consistency, and fitness for defined analytics use cases. You will define data quality rules and thresholds, design automated monitoring mechanisms, and lead remediation efforts with source system owners when issues arise.6. Lead Taxonomy Design & Canonical Data ModelingThis is one of the most impactful parts of the role. You will lead the design, alignment, and implementation of an employee intent taxonomy and a service accountability model — enabling consistent classification of chat transcripts and employee interactions for reporting on recurring issues and identifying the accountable service team to address them. You will also govern the canonical data model that standardizes definitions and structures across all support tiers.7. Partner on Data ArchitectureYou will collaborate with Data Architects and Engineering teams — reviewing conceptual, logical, and physical data models, integration designs, and data flows. You will ensure architectural designs meet business needs, align with the canonical model, and support scalability. You bring enough data architecture knowledge to evaluate trade-offs and recommend improvements constructively.8. Drive Metadata Management & Data CatalogingYou will manage metadata for Employee Care data assets and lead data cataloging activities — ensuring all published assets carry complete business definitions, lineage, ownership, quality metrics, and usage guidance. You will champion catalog adoption across the analytics community.9. Own Data Asset Validation & TestingYou will define test cases, expected outcomes, and acceptance criteria for validating data assets before production release. You will maintain regression test suites and partner with QA, engineering, and business SMEs to execute validation and secure sign-off.Job QualificationsRequiredDegree in Computer Science, Information Management, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or a related field (Master's preferred)3+ years of experience in data stewardship, data management, or data governanceHands-on experience managing data from ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM / ticket management platformProven experience designing and running data change management processes, including regression and NNIT testingStrong understanding of canonical data modeling, taxonomies, and data standardization across complex, multi-tier environmentsWorking knowledge of data architecture principles — enough to critically engage with and contribute to architecture artifactsStrong hands-on SQL skills and experience with data quality assessmentExperience working in or with DatabricksDemonstrated ability to partner with business stakeholders to align on KPI definitions and business terminologyPreferredBackground in Employee Care, HR Services, IT Service Management, or a Shared Services environmentFamiliarity with modern cloud data platforms (Databricks, Azure, AWS)Experience using or enabling Power BI or comparable BI/analytics toolsCertifications in data governance or data management or ITSM domainsExperience contributing to data contracts with SaaS vendorsWe offerP&G-sized projects and access to world leading IT partners and technologies from Day 1.Wide range of self-development possibilities (training and certifications paths).Competitive starting salary and benefits program (private health care, P&G stock, saving plans, sport cards).Regular salary increases and possible promotions - in line with your results and performance.Opportunity to change role every few years to be in the best place for you and best for P&G.At Procter & Gamble, we embrace a hybrid work model that combines the flexibility of remote work with the collaborative benefits of in-office engagement. Employees can enjoy the option to work from home two days a week while also spending time in the office to foster teamwork and enhance communication.At P&G #weseeequalWe are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. At P&G we strive to build a culture where everyone feels welcome, included, and able to bring their full selves to work.We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process. Please click here if you require an accommodation during the application process. Please make sure to wait to hear back from us regarding your accommodation before proceeding with the online assessment, we thank you in advance for your patience.Kindly be advised that at P&G, employment is exclusively extended on the basis of 'Umowa o Pracę' (Full-time Employment Contract). Apply only if you agree to these conditions.

jobposting.description: About SurveilySurveily is the AI safety and operations intelligence company for industrial workplaces. We build our own AI and video-analytics product that turns the cameras companies already have into an intelligent system - detecting hazards in real time and preventing incidents before they happen. We operate at the intersection ofAI and Industry 4.0, solving a high-priority business problem around workplace safety and operational efficiency. Our platform integrates with 95% of existing digital camera infrastructure, and our customers have seen a 1152% increase in unsafe-behaviour visibility, 72% fewer safety incidents, and a 25% reduction in LTIR.Now we are scaling, and the 3D content you create will directly train the computer-vision models that keep real people safe on real industrial sites.About the roleOur object-detection models (YOLO) are trained in large part on synthetic data: photorealistic 3D scenes of industrial environments - warehouses, production halls, yards - populated with people, forklifts, machinery, and PPE. The pipeline already exists and runs end-to-end: a Python-native SimulationApp drives Synthetic Data Generation from an established OpenUSD scene and asset library. You are not starting from zero. What we need is the person who owns this pipeline and makes it dependable: creating new assets in Blender, maintaining and extending the existing USD library, and running SDG batches that deliver clean, training-ready datasets to the ML team - on time, every time.The challengeYour work has downstream consumers - automated pipelines and ML engineers - so a broken hierarchy, a missing semantic label, or a scene that 'works on my machine' has a real cost: failed generation runs, wasted GPU hours, and models that miss hazards in the field. This is not a portfolio-art role. Visual quality matters, but consistency, technical correctness, and predictable delivery matter more. We are looking for someone who treats the asset library like production code - versioned, validated, documented - and treats a dataset handed off on schedule as the win.What you'll ownAsset Creation (Blender)Model, texture, and optimise new 3D assets - industrial equipment, vehicles (forklifts, trucks), people, PPE, props, and environment elements.Export to USD cleanly and consistently: correct scale, pivots, hierarchies, naming, materials, and the semantic labels SDG annotation depends on.Keep polycount, texture budgets, and LODs fit for large-scale batch rendering.USD Library StewardshipEdit, repair, and extend existing OpenUSD assets and scenes - composition arcs (references, payloads, variants), layering, materials, semantics.Maintain a versioned, documented library with predictable structure, so anyone on the team can reuse assets without surprises.Validate every asset before it enters the library - catch broken references, wrong units, or missing semantics before a failed training run does.Synthetic Data GenerationOwn and operate the SDG process end to end: configure and launch generation batches - scene selection, domain randomisation (lighting, camera poses, textures, placement), annotation outputs for YOLO training.Monitor runs, verify output and label quality, and hand off clean, documented datasets to the ML team on schedule.Close the loop with ML engineers: when a model underperforms on a class, translate that into concrete asset or randomisation changes and re-generate.What you'll bring3+ years of professional 3D experience (games, VFX, simulation, archviz, or synthetic data) with strong Blender skills - modelling, UVs, texturing, materials.Hands-on OpenUSD experience. You understand composition (references, variants, layers), can debug a broken stage, and know why a mangled hierarchy or wrong up-axis breaks a pipeline.Working Python. Enough to run, configure, and lightly modify pipeline scripts - you'll be driving the SDG app, not building it.Computer-vision awareness. You understand what makes synthetic data useful for detection models: annotation types, domain randomisation, the sim-to-real gap.High ownership and discipline. You plan your work, communicate status honestly, flag problems early, and finish what you start - a track record of reliable, selfdirected delivery.Communicative English and Polish for day-to-day collaboration with the team.Nice to haveExperience with NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, or Replicator specifically. Experience training or evaluating detection models (YOLO or similar) - even at hobby level.PBR workflows, Substance Painter/Designer, or photogrammetry.Git or other version control for asset management.Comfort working with AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) in your daily workflow - for scripting, debugging, and learning new tools fast.Exposure to industrial, logistics, or safety environments.What we offerA mission with real impact- the datasets you generate train models that prevent injuries on real industrial sites.Full ownership of the 3D content and SDG pipeline - your improvements ship straight into production models.A proven, working pipeline - you are not starting from zero.Direct collaboration with the ML team and founders; short feedback loops, no bureaucracy. An LLM-backed house - you get full access to frontier AI models (Claude and others) as a daily co-pilot for Python scripting, USD debugging, and Omniverse work, so you're never stuck alone on the technical side.Hardware capable of the job (workstation-class GPU) and the tools you need.Hybrid work from our Wrocław office.A B2B contract with compensation matched to experience.Recruitment processWe will contact only selected candidates whose CV and portfolio clearly demonstrate the skills we are looking for. The process consists of a CV and portfolio review, a 5-minute phone call, a 30-minute video interview, and a practical task — modelling a small asset in Blender, exporting it to USD to our spec, and walking us through your validation checks. We will get back to you at the end of each stage.Please include with your application: a portfolio or asset samples, and - if possible - an example of USD or pipeline work.If you have more questions, please email us at: talent@surveily.com

jobposting.description: As a Senior Design System Designer, you will join the core team responsible for the S4D (System for Design) design system. ResponsibilitiesSystem Design & Evolution: Create, maintain, and scale accessible (WCAG 2.2 AA) and reusable UI components, patterns, and design foundations for the S4D system.Libraries & Design Tokens Management: Optimize Figma library structures, managing variables, design tokens, and multi-brand token models across platforms.Technical Documentation: Author clear, developer-facing usage adoption and promote best practices.Key Requirements (Must Have)Design Systems Expertise: 5+ years of experience building, maintaining, and scaling enterprise-grade design systems, component libraries, or UX frameworks across multiple products and brands.Advanced Figma Mastery: Deep expertise in component creation, variants, variables, design tokens, auto-layout, library maintenance, and governance workflows.Tokens & Architecture Awareness: Hands-on knowledge of design tokens, multi-brand foundations, color systems, and the mapping between design files and code implementation.Frontend knowledge of WCAG 2.2 AA standards with an accessibility-by-design mindset.Agile & Stakeholder Management: Strong communication skills to justify design decisions, advocate for system thinking, and impact on quality and accessibility.Multi-Brand & Multi-Platform Experience: Proven track record scaling design foundations across complex, multi-region digital ecosystems.

jobposting.description: Welcome to the Delivery Experience (DEX) Data Science team, where we pride ourselves on developing data-driven products that propel the business and logistics of Allegro forward. Our expertise spans across a wide range of logistics process optimization, volume management, and delivery time prediction. We utilize a mix of Machine Learning (ML), Operations Research optimization tools, Google Cloud Platform components, and advanced data analytics to solve complex business challenges. We are building core Artificial Intelligence systems that dynamically optimize delivery costs and improve the efficiency of our network - including parcel lockers (One Box) and courier operations. Joining us means becoming part of a Data Science group that collaborates closely with product, engineering, and operations to build AI/ML systems running directly in production environments. Important things for you: The salary range for this position depending on the skill set is as follows (contract of employment, tax-deductible cost):PLN 14 600 - 20 825Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.Our team is based in Warsaw. In your daily work you will handle the following tasks:Data Modeling & Analysis: Creating complex data models using machine learning, deep learning, time series forecasting, and survival models.Operations Research & Optimization: Utilizing mathematical optimization techniques (such as MILP and OR-Tools) to solve complex logistics problems.AI System Development & Innovation: Designing, developing, and maintaining core AI/ML systems directly in production environments, as well as researching new AI methodologies.Data Processing & Automation: Employing Python and advanced SQL to process, automate, and analyze large datasets, ensuring high-quality input data.Data Management & Pipeline Reliability: Collaborating closely with engineering teams to foster the availability, integrity, accuracy, and scalability of ML pipelines and workflow orchestrations.Research & Problem-Solving: Translating complex business challenges and supply chain bottlenecks into AI/ML or optimization problems, proactively testing novel approaches to minimize costs.Collaboration & Communication: Working effectively with numerous DEX stakeholders throughout the full lifecycle of AI/ML systems, providing clear communication of advanced insights, and fostering knowledge sharing within the team. We are looking for people who:Experience: Have at least 2 years of experience in building Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence solutions deployed in production.AI/ML Knowledge: A deep understanding of AI/ML methods, especially decision tree-based algorithms, time series models, and neural networks.Programming & Tools: Proficient in Python and highly comfortable with software development tools. Experience with core AI/ML Python libraries: Pandas/Polars, Scikit-learn, CatBoost, Optuna, Prophet, PyTorch, and LangGraph.Databases: Advanced knowledge of SQL.Analytical Thinking: Ability to translate business challenges into AI/ML problems and tackle them using novel approaches.Languages: Polish B2 and English B2.Education: Graduated with a degree strongly related to quantitative methods or statistical & mathematical modeling, such as Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Engineering, Logistics, or a similar major. Nice to have: Proficiency in workflow orchestration and AI platforms, including Airflow / Google Cloud Composer and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI).Familiarity with Operations Research concepts, Mathematical Optimization techniques (like MILP), and Graph Analytics.Experience with geospatial data and relevant libraries (e.g., GeoPandas, H3). Why is it worth working with us?Data-Driven Impact: Data Science plays a key role at Allegro. Our models and analyses significantly optimize logistics operations, lowering costs and shortening delivery times on one of the world's largest e-commerce platforms.Innovation: Direct involvement in building optimization solutions that revolutionize the logistics network and last-mile processes.Skill Development: You will work alongside top specialists, gaining access to large-scale data sets and a modern technology stack on GCP.Proven Solutions: Our solutions aren't just theoretical. They demonstrate effectiveness and performance in real-world production environments, handling real logistics conditions and massive e-commerce scale.What's in it for you: Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4 days in the office / 1 day remote) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).A 16' or 14' MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories.A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings. An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal. Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy. And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here. #goodtobehere means that: You will join a team you can count on - we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA.You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.You will value our Developer Experience and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Thanks to this, you can contribute to Allegro from your very first days on the job. You will be equipped with modern AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on developing new services and refining existing ones (also leveraging AI support).You will create solutions that will be used (and loved!) by your friends, family and millions of our customers.You will meet the Allegro Scale, which starts with over 1000 microservices, an open-source data bus (Hermes) with 300K+ rps, a Service Mesh with 1M+ rps, tens of petabytes of data, and production-used machine learning. You will become part of Allegro Tech - We speak at industry conferences, cooperate with tech communities, run our own blog (it's been over 10 years!), record podcasts, lead guilds, and we organize our own internal conference - the Allegro Tech Meeting. We create solutions we love (and can) to talk about!  Send us your CV and… see you at Allegro!

jobposting.description: About the job:At Allegro, we operate at a massive scale where performance and reliability are paramount. Within the Razor team, we maintain the critical backend infrastructure for the entire checkout and purchase path. Our service acts as the central hub, providing essential offer data to nearly 60 critical services - including Show Product, Listings, and Cart - across mobile, web, and desktop. Operating on nearly 500 instances and handling traffic of up to 50,000 requests per second, this high-throughput environment demands exceptional focus on high availability, Java performance optimization, and scalable architecture.Important things for you:Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.The salary range for this position depending on the skill set is as follows (contract of employment, tax-deductible cost):PLN 18 850 - 25 900Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.Long term discretionary incentive plan based on Allegro.eu shares (restricted stock units).Our team is based in Toruń.What You'll Do:Massive Scale: Design, build, and optimize systems that handle thousands of requests per second. This is high-availability, high-performance engineering in practice.Master advanced technologies: Work in a world-class, cloud-native environment (GCP). Our core technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, MongoDB, microservices, and Airflow (Big Data).True Ownership & Autonomy: We live by the 'you build it, you run it' philosophy. You'll join an agile, autonomous team with full ownership of your microservices—from design to deployment.Engage with diverse business initiatives: Partner with PMs to analyze requirements and drive numerous business initiatives across Allegro.Drive innovation with LLM: Participate in the development of new tools based on Large Language Models.Work with an experienced team: Benefit from a high-agency environment with support and development opportunities provided by senior experts. As a senior developer, you will also have the opportunity to share your knowledge and mentor colleagues with less experience.Ensure system reliability: Maintain the stability of complex architectures through participation in on-call duty.We are looking for people with:Commercial experience: 5 years of experience in building and maintaining complex, high-scalability systems.Strong technical foundation: Proficiency in Java (primary) and Kotlin, with a focus on reactive programming.Advanced database skills (nice to have): Hands-on experience and advanced knowledge of MongoDB.Business-oriented mindset: Experience in collaborating with Product Managers and analyzing business requirements.Team collaboration skills: A track record of frequent cooperation with other technical teams to deliver shared goals.Reliability and ownership: Readiness to participate in a structured on-call rotation to ensure system stability.What's in it for you:Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).A 16' or 14' MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories.A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings. An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal. Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy. And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here.#goodtobehere means that:You will join a team you can count on - we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA.You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.You will value our Developer Experience and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Thanks to this, you can contribute to Allegro from your very first days on the job. You will be equipped with modern AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on developing new services and refining existing ones (also leveraging AI support).You will create solutions that will be used (and loved!) by your friends, family and millions of our customers.You will meet the Allegro Scale, which starts with over 1000 microservices, an open-source data bus (Hermes) with 300K+ rps, a Service Mesh with 1M+ rps, tens of petabytes of data, and production-used machine learning. You will become part of Allegro Tech - We speak at industry conferences, cooperate with tech communities, run our own blog (it's been over 10 years!), record podcasts, lead guilds, and we organize our own internal conference - the Allegro Tech Meeting. We create solutions we love (and can) to talk about!  Send us your CV and… see you at Allegro!

jobposting.description: Oppdragsbeskrivelse:I Helse Nord har digitalisering stort fokus. Dette løses gjennom store, regionale prosjekter, oglokale prosjekter ved foretakene. HN IKTs bidrag i lokale prosjekter organiseres i hovedsak somoppdrag. I henhold til IKT styringsmodell i Helse Nord, er det HN IKT som har ansvar for all driftav infrastruktur og arbeidsflater. For å håndtere slike oppdrag, er det etablert en prosess med definertefaser, rollebeskrivelser i foretakene og Helse Nord IKT og maler og rutiner som skal benyttes.Det er for tiden stor oppdragsmengde fra foretakene og Helse Nord IKT har derfor behov forÅ utvide leveransekapasiteten ift. 'Nye Tjenester'. Nye Tjenester er et felles rammeverk forbestillinger av nye tjenester fra HNIKT av helseforetakene i regionen.OPPDRAGET ER DEKKET PR. I DAG.Konsulentens oppgaverKonsulenten som leies inn vil måtte kunne fungere som både løsningsarkitekt ogoppdragsansvarlig. jobposting.description: We are seeking experienced Product Owners to join a major transformation programme responsible for shaping the future of a global Payments Operations function.As part of a multi-year transformation, you will play a key role in replacing a legacy payments platform with a new core payments engine, while helping redefine how operational teams work across Payments Processing, Payment Investigations, and Sanctions & Name Screening.This role is not a traditional Scrum Product Owner position focused solely on backlog management.We are looking for consultative Product Owners who can work with senior stakeholders to challenge existing operating models, shape future capabilities, and define strategic product roadmaps. You will be responsible for ensuring the products you own deliver meaningful operational improvements while supporting a broader Target Operating Model (TOM) transformation.If you are someone who naturally asks, 'Why do we do it this way?' and enjoys influencing change across complex operational environments, we would love to hear from you.The Role:You will own one or more operational products supporting the Payments Operations estate and be responsible for driving their strategic evolution.Working closely with Operations, Technology, Architecture, and Change teams, you will define product direction, prioritize investment, and ensure solutions support both immediate business needs and the organization’s long-term transformation agenda.You will also collaborate with Business Analysts leading operating model redesigns, ensuring product strategy and operational change remain aligned.Key Responsibilities:Own and evolve the product roadmap for operational payment capabilities.Define and communicate a clear product vision aligned to the wider transformation strategy.Partner with Operations, Technology, and Change teams to deliver business value.Challenge existing processes and identify opportunities to simplify and modernize operational workflows.Translate business priorities into product outcomes and delivery roadmaps.Prioritize features and capabilities based on customer, operational, and regulatory needs.Work closely with engineering teams delivering the new core payments platform.Ensure products support future Target Operating Models and operational readiness.Influence senior stakeholders across Product, Operations, and Technology.Drive adoption of automation, AI, and digital capabilities where appropriate.Balance strategic product development with ongoing BAU and regulatory priorities.We are looking for Product Owners who think beyond user stories and sprint planning.The strongest candidates will have experience acting as strategic partners to the business, helping shape future operating models and influencing how operational products evolve over time.You will ideally have experience:Owning products within complex Payments or Financial Services environments.Defining product strategy and long-term roadmaps.Supporting large-scale operational transformation programmes.Working alongside Business Analysts delivering Target Operating Model (TOM) initiatives.Challenging existing ways of working and driving continuous improvement.Working closely with engineering teams delivering enterprise platforms.Managing senior stakeholder relationships across Operations, Technology, and Product.Making commercial and strategic prioritisation decisions.Domain Experience:We are looking for Product Owners with experience across one or more of the following operational domains:Payments Processing:Experience supporting end-to-end payment processing operations, with an understanding of payment lifecycles, operational workflows, Straight Through Processing (STP), automation, and the transition towards 24/7, follow-the-sun operating models.Payment Investigations:Experience working with products supporting payment investigations, exception handling, and operational case management, helping improve efficiency across complex operational workflows.Sanctions & Name Screening:Experience supporting Financial Crime products relating to sanctions screening, name screening, alert management, or operational compliance workflows.Essential Experience:Product Ownership within Financial Services.Strong Payments Operations knowledge.Experience working on enterprise transformation programmes.Product roadmap ownership.Agile product delivery.Operational process improvement.Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.Experience working with cross-functional teams across Product, Technology, and Operations.Desirable ExperienceCore payments platform transformation.Target Operating Model (TOM) programmes.AI or Intelligent Automation initiatives.Workflow redesign.Global operating models across the UK, India, and Eastern Europe.Success in this role isn't measured by the number of features delivered - it's measured by the operational outcomes achieved.You will help build products that enable simpler, smarter, and more scalable ways of working, ensuring Payments Operations is fit for the future while supporting the delivery of a modern core payments platform.

jobposting.description: Welcome to the Delivery Experience (DEX) Data Science team, where we pride ourselves on developing data-driven products that propel the business and logistics of Allegro forward. Our expertise spans across a wide range of logistics process optimization, volume management, and delivery time prediction. We utilize a mix of Machine Learning (ML), Operations Research optimization tools, Google Cloud Platform components, and advanced data analytics to solve complex business challenges. We are building core Artificial Intelligence systems that dynamically optimize delivery costs and improve the efficiency of our network - including parcel lockers (One Box) and courier operations. Joining us means becoming part of a Data Science group that collaborates closely with product, engineering, and operations to build AI/ML systems running directly in production environments. Important things for you: The salary range for this position depending on the skill set is as follows (contract of employment, tax-deductible cost):PLN 14 600 - 20 825Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.Our team is based in Warsaw. In your daily work you will handle the following tasks:Data Modeling & Analysis: Creating complex data models using machine learning, deep learning, time series forecasting, and survival models.Operations Research & Optimization: Utilizing mathematical optimization techniques (such as MILP and OR-Tools) to solve complex logistics problems.AI System Development & Innovation: Designing, developing, and maintaining core AI/ML systems directly in production environments, as well as researching new AI methodologies.Data Processing & Automation: Employing Python and advanced SQL to process, automate, and analyze large datasets, ensuring high-quality input data.Data Management & Pipeline Reliability: Collaborating closely with engineering teams to foster the availability, integrity, accuracy, and scalability of ML pipelines and workflow orchestrations.Research & Problem-Solving: Translating complex business challenges and supply chain bottlenecks into AI/ML or optimization problems, proactively testing novel approaches to minimize costs.Collaboration & Communication: Working effectively with numerous DEX stakeholders throughout the full lifecycle of AI/ML systems, providing clear communication of advanced insights, and fostering knowledge sharing within the team. We are looking for people who:Experience: Have at least 2 years of experience in building Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence solutions deployed in production.AI/ML Knowledge: A deep understanding of AI/ML methods, especially decision tree-based algorithms, time series models, and neural networks.Programming & Tools: Proficient in Python and highly comfortable with software development tools. Experience with core AI/ML Python libraries: Pandas/Polars, Scikit-learn, CatBoost, Optuna, Prophet, PyTorch, and LangGraph.Databases: Advanced knowledge of SQL.Analytical Thinking: Ability to translate business challenges into AI/ML problems and tackle them using novel approaches.Languages: Polish B2 and English B2.Education: Graduated with a degree strongly related to quantitative methods or statistical & mathematical modeling, such as Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Engineering, Logistics, or a similar major. Nice to have: Proficiency in workflow orchestration and AI platforms, including Airflow / Google Cloud Composer and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI).Familiarity with Operations Research concepts, Mathematical Optimization techniques (like MILP), and Graph Analytics.Experience with geospatial data and relevant libraries (e.g., GeoPandas, H3). Why is it worth working with us?Data-Driven Impact: Data Science plays a key role at Allegro. Our models and analyses significantly optimize logistics operations, lowering costs and shortening delivery times on one of the world's largest e-commerce platforms.Innovation: Direct involvement in building optimization solutions that revolutionize the logistics network and last-mile processes.Skill Development: You will work alongside top specialists, gaining access to large-scale data sets and a modern technology stack on GCP.Proven Solutions: Our solutions aren't just theoretical. They demonstrate effectiveness and performance in real-world production environments, handling real logistics conditions and massive e-commerce scale.What's in it for you: Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4 days in the office / 1 day remote) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).A 16' or 14' MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories.A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings. An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal. Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy. And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here. #goodtobehere means that: You will join a team you can count on - we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA.You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.You will value our Developer Experience and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. jobposting.description: WHY THIS ROLEZadbano is a Polish logistics company in a real transformation towards a technology-platform model. Technology is where we build our operating model and our business advantage. Seven engineers today. This role owns the people, the organisation of work and the quality of delivery — player-coach, side by side with the Head of Innovation who sets direction. It is for someone who wants real influence and to see the effect of their work in how the company runs, without escaping engineering into pure management.CORE OF THE ROLEFull responsibility for the people, the organisation of work and the quality of delivery — player-coach: you lead the team, and you sit down to the analysis, the code or the incident yourself when that is the shortest way to a solution.WHAT YOU WILL DO● Lead a team of 6–9 engineers (business applications, support and infrastructure line): 1:1s, feedback, growth, recruiting● Own the organisation of work: decomposition of business needs into tasks, prioritisation, queueing and flow in JIRA — the team always knows what now, what next and why; business sees status without asking● Predictable, complete delivery in a two-week rhythm (strict DoR / DoD); reliability: incident and problem management, RCA with permanent root-cause removal● Technical authority: design and code review, mentoring, engineering decisions where the team is blocked, own contribution where it speeds things up● AI-native engineering as the team standard — AI is the default way of working, from code assistants and agents to automated ticket triage — measured by real effect, not fashion● Application and data security: DevSecOps, vulnerability and access management, backup / DR, incident response, GDPR compliance, vendor oversight● Stewardship of long-lived in-house systems (TMS / WMS, e-commerce, integrations): maintenance, refactoring, gradual modernisation without breaking business continuity; recommendations (modernise, cloud, build vs buy) backed by an operating-cost caseWHAT WE LOOK FOR● 7+ years in software engineering, 3+ years leading a team● Genuinely hands-on: you read code, run reviews, understand architectural consequences and can still take a problem from analysis to a working solution. Our dominant tech stack relies on: Node.js, TypeScript, React, Vue, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes● Advanced JIRA practice — backlog, boards, dashboards, reporting; you lead the team in it, not just know the tool● AI-native engineer: AI tools are your daily workshop (code assistants, agents, data and document analysis), you have rolled them out to a team and can show what changed● Maintaining and modernising long-lived legacy systems without interrupting the business● Practical security: DevSecOps, vulnerabilities and access, backup / DR, incident response● Modern delivery cycle: CI/CD, cloud (AWS / GCP), Kubernetes, Docker, observability● Modern leadership: servant leadership, OKR, Kanban / Scrum without dogma, management by metrics, high-performance culture● Fluent at the technology–business interface; Polish and English at working levelNice to have: Logistics domain (TMS / WMS), ERP and e-commerce integrations; experience transforming an IT team or department; FinOps — cloud and licence cost awareness.WHAT WE OFFER● A real mandate and a single point of accountability, with a short decision path● Direct work with the Head of Innovation and visibility at board level● A modern system of work based on metrics and AI● A transformation with real business stakes: logistics and e-commerce, systems the whole company runs on daily● A written 30-day goal agreed with you before the offer — and regular reviews on impact, in the openYOUR FIRST 30 DAYSWe align on your first 30-day goal together — with you and the team — based on the current focus areas, before the offer. Both sides sign the same sentence.Then, in regular reviews:DORA metrics measured and improving sprint over sprint; every incident closed with an RCA and a removed cause; AI-assisted practices adopted with a measured effect on lead time; cost per delivered order trending down.HOW WE WORKA maturing, deliberately built system of work: strict Definition of Ready / Definition of Done, management by metrics (DORA, SPACE), AI-assisted triage of support requests, a portal for internal customers. Our north star is the value of delivered work confirmed by the business. No methodological dogma — methods serve delivery.HOW WE WORK TOGETHERA team that agrees on “why” before deciding “how”.You join a team that questions its own assumptions before it commits, asks customers and clients the questions that move things forward, and uses new technologies to see what it cannot see alone. Every task opens with for whom and what should change. Ideas are tested against a KPI together, kept when they work and let go when they do not — without blame. What you build here is a track record of proven impact, and it is yours.THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS● Step 1 — A conversation, not a CV screen: Thirty minutes about what you are best at and one thing you proved. No title matching.● Step 2 — Working session: Two hours with the team on a real zadbano. case. We watch which questions they ask and how they align on the why.● Step 3 — The 30-day goal: We write the first-30-days expectation together with the candidate before the offer — both sides sign the same sentence.● Step 4 — Review, then regular: Day 30: did the result land? Then regular reviews on impact, in the open decision log like everyone else.Question before you decide. Align on intention. Measure together, show the impact.This is how we take care of people. This is how we take care of everything.

jobposting.description: Tu Axence. Mówią o nas, że jesteśmy zespołem niezwykle utalentowanych i zaangażowanych ludzi, którzy na co dzień kształtują przyszłość bezpieczeństwa IT.   Tworzymy oprogramowanie, które usprawnia i upraszcza pracę działów IT oraz edukujemy o cyberbezpieczeństwie. Stawiamy na sprawczość, elastyczność i kreatywność – działamy bez korporacyjnych opóźnień i zbędnej biurokracji. Dostarczamy rozwiązania dla działów IT, zarówno w Polsce, jak i na świecie. I robimy to z pasją.   Stajemy przed nowymi wyzwaniami i rozwijamy nasze projekty. Dlatego szukamy nie tylko utalentowanej, ale i zmotywowanej osoby, która dołączy do nas na stanowisko IT Support Specialist. Na tym stanowisku będziesz odpowiadać za kompleksową obsługę techniczną naszych klientów zewnętrznych w pełnym cyklu życia zgłoszenia, jak również za sprawne wsparcie techniczne pracowników Axence. Samodzielna obsługa klientów zewnętrznych w pełnym cyklu życia zgłoszenia, zgodnie z przyjętym workflow, przy zachowaniu wysokich standardów i uprzejmego podejścia. Diagnozowanie i rozwiązywanie problemów technicznych klientów związanych z oprogramowaniem oraz prowadzenie technicznych sesji zdalnych (MS Teams, TeamViewer).Analiza logów produktów w celu weryfikacji zgłoszeń oraz reprodukcja błędów zgłaszanych przez klientów w środowiskach testowych.Współpraca z Działem Developmentu przy analizie problemów oraz testowanie poprawek i nowych wersji produktów.Samodzielne wsparcie techniczne pracowników Axence poprzez rozwiązywanie problemów sprzętowych i programowych, instalacja i konfiguracja oprogramowania oraz przygotowywanie sprzętu dla nowych osób.Dokumentowanie zgłoszeń i rozwiązań w systemie ticketowym (Zendesk, HelpDesk) oraz tworzenie bazy wiedzy o powtarzających się problemach.Tworzenie i zarządzanie bazą wzorców oprogramowania oraz przygotowywanie instrukcji i dokumentacji technicznej dla Działu.Wsparcie Działów Handlowych w kontaktach z klientami od strony merytorycznej i technicznej. through ServiceNow or similar workflow platforms.Lead or support root cause analysis for recurring or high-impact IAM / PAM issues.Participate in operational readiness, testing, validation, and change
