jobposting.description: Vi søker en erfaren seniorkonsulent til å videreføre et pågående oppdrag innen Azure. Behovet oppstår fordi nåværende konsulent ikke har kapasitet til å fortsette og vi ønsker å sikre videreføring av nødvendig kompetanse og kontinuitet i oppdraget.Den vi søker må raskt kunne sette seg inn i eksisterende oppsett og forvaltning, og bidra til en stabil videreføring av arbeidet.Den ideelle kandidaten vil ha følgende kvalifikasjoner:Teknisk bakgrunn:Solid erfaring med Azure core management, core infrastructure og hybrid cloud. Vi bruker GitHub for forvaltning og videreutvikling av våre Azure-miljøer, og kandidaten må ha god erfaring med GitHub som plattform for arbeidsflyt, kodeforvaltning og automatisering.Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) og sky-governance:Erfaring med etablering og forvaltning av CAF-prosesser og sky-governance-strukturer.Policy og compliance i Azure:Konsulenten må ha solid erfaring med etablering, forvaltning og oppfølging av policy og compliance i Azure. Dette omfatter praktisk bruk av Azure Policy, styring av etterlevelse, vurdering og håndtering av avvik, samt implementering av kontrollmekanismer som understøtter sikker, sporbar og standardisert bruk av Azure-plattformen.Erfaring med flere skyplattformer:Primærkompetansen skal ligge i Azure, men erfaring fra Google Cloud og Amazon Web Services er ønskelig, men ikke et krav.Sertifiseringer og Azure-kompetanse:Relevante Azure-sertifiseringer og praktisk erfaring med forvaltning og drift av Azure-miljøer.Forvaltning av skyløsninger:Erfaring med IaC, spesielt Terraform, Bicep, PowerShell og Azure CLI.Forvaltning av selvbetjeningsløsninger:Vi har etablert selvbetjeningsløsninger i Azure, blant annet for opprettelse av Azure Application Registrations og tilhørende Entra ID-grupper (PIM) via GitHub og Pull Requests. Kandidaten må kunne videreføre og drifte disse løsningene.Arbeidsform:Evne til å arbeide både selvstendig og i team. Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk, både skriftlig og muntlig, er nødvendig.  Norsk er arbeidsspråk i Statens pensjonskasse Oppstart: Ønsket oppstart er 15 oktober 2026, eller så tidlig som mulig etter denne datoen. Konsulenten vi har i dag vil jobbe ut oktober, og vi hadde ønsket en kompetanseoverlapping.Varighet: 31.12. 2026. Det er mulighet for å forlenge avtalen inn i 2027 basert på behov og gjensidig enighet, og uttaket kan justeres opp eller ned ved forlengelse.Omfang: 40% i den angitte perioden. Arbeid utover dette avtales særskilt og vil være avhengig av Azure tiltak i andre avdelinger/enheter i SPKArbeidssted: Skøyen Det kan bli aktuelt med overtid i oppdragsperioden da arbeid som kan forstyrre ordinær produksjon, må utføres utenfor ordinær arbeidstid. Overtidsbetaling vil bli utbetalt i henhold til Arbeidsmiljølovens bestemmelser. Reisekostnader dekkes normalt ikke, med mindre det foreligger særskilte forhold, og må avtales særskilt i det enkelte tilfellet med oppdragsgiver. Frist for å melde interesse: 29 september Ta kontakt for kompetansematrise

jobposting.description: The Data Science & Analytics team at Asana is how the company turns data into decisions — defining the questions that matter, surfacing the answers, and making sure insight is at the center of every critical product and business call. As a Senior Analytical Engineer, you sit at the intersection of Data Engineering, Analytics, and Data Science, and you own the data foundations for a business domain end to end. Your mandate is to turn raw data into reliable, business-ready datasets that PMs, analysts, data scientists, and leaders actually trust and use — and to define the business logic and metric standards that make AI-powered self-serve trustworthy. You consume governed Silver tables and produce the Gold layer and semantic layer beneath Asana's most important metrics, dashboards, and Genie spaces. This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday, with the option to work from home on Wednesdays and, depending on the work and the teams you partner with, on Fridays. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office expectations.What you'll achieve:Own the Gold layer for a given business domain (e.g. PLG funnel, marketing attribution, revenue, NPI/AWM): Design and continuously improve the curated, dimensional data models that downstream dashboards, Genie spaces, and ELT reporting depend on.Implement the canonical business logic behind your domain's core KPIs: Translate KPIs into governed, versioned metric marts that resolve 'this number doesn't match' disputes for good.Build and curate the semantic layer and Genie spaces that power self-serve in your domain: Author the metadata, documentation, and prompt/metric definitions that let stakeholders query governed data in plain language through Claude and Databricks Genie.Own the metric dictionary for your domain: a single source of truth for what each metric means, who owns it, and where to find it. Partner with peers across DS&A to keep KPI definitions consistent where domains overlap.Author data contracts and SLAs at the Silver→Gold boundary, partnering with Horizontal Data Engineering on the inputs you depend on, and owning data quality, freshness, and oncall for Gold/metric-mart failures in your domain.Build and maintain certified, board-ready dashboards on governed Gold data, partnering with Data Science to translate insight requirements into trusted, reusable products rather than one-off builds.Partner directly with Product & Business, Data Science, and Engineering to turn ambiguous, underspecified questions into scalable datasets — anticipating downstream reporting impacts before they become incidents, and raising the data-model quality bar across the domains you touch. About you: 4+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a closely related analytics role, with a track record of independently owning the data models a team relies on for decisions.Advanced SQL and strong data modeling fundamentals: dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and semantic layer design.Hands-on experience with a transformation framework (dbt or equivalent), orchestration tooling (e.g. Airflow), version control (Git), and modern warehouse/lakehouse platforms (Databricks experience preferred).Practical experience with data quality testing and observability, schema management and data contracts, and query/model performance and cost tuning.Demonstrated domain fluency in at least one business area (e.g. PLG funnels, SLG pipeline, marketing attribution, Product telemetry, revenue/ARR) and the judgment to translate 'I don't trust this number' into a specific, durable model fix.Strong cross-functional partnership skills: requirement gathering, prioritization, documentation and enablement, driving alignment on metric definitions, and explaining technical tradeoffs to non-technical partners.Curiosity about AI-native analytics — NL2SQL, metadata/semantic layers for self-serve, and using tools like Claude and Genie to multiply your reach rather than replace rigor. Exposure to Unity Catalog, Looker/LookML, or reverse-ETL/activation (Salesforce, Marketo, Gainsight) is a plus.We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That's because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don't be shy - apply today.At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.What we’ll offerGenerous, transparent and fair compensation system (base salary and RSUs)Contract of Employment (and the option of 50% tax deductible costs for author’s rights usage in respect of applicable roles ) Health insurance with dental and travel coverage (Lux Med) Breakfast and lunch catering on the days that you work from the officeVacation allowanceCareer growth budget Home office setup budget Gym/Fitness cardFertility healthcare and family-forming support with CarrotMental Health Support in Modern HealthGroup life insuranceMacBooks with all necessary accessoriesFor this role, the estimated base salary range is between 20,833 - 23,700 PLN gross per month (subject to all taxes and necessary deductions). The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity and sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.#LI-HybridAbout usAsana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.Join Asana’s Talent Network to stay up to date on job opportunities and life at Asana.

jobposting.description: Want to make an impact? We offer that Due to continued growth, we are hiring a Security Tooling Engineer to bring together security signal from across the environment: network, endpoint, identity, and CI/CD, into a single, coherent detection and response capability. The successful candidate will own log aggregation, data correlation, and alerting, turning disparate security telemetry into an actionable, unified view. This is a hands-on engineering role suited to an open-source-first, self-hosted-first technology approach. The successful candidate will be expected to build, integrate, and extend tooling directly rather than default to commercial, vendor-managed products. The specific platform is less important than the candidate's demonstrated ability to design and operate this kind of capability, and candidates from a variety of tooling backgrounds are welcome to apply. The environment is expected to evolve, and the role requires someone who can design for that - understanding how new data sources, tools, and systems can be brought into the existing platforms and detection capabilities through reusable integration patterns, rather than treating each addition as a one-off integration. Key Responsibilities: ·       Own and administer a central log aggregation and detection platform, including ingestion pipeline design, data retention/lifecycle management, and query/alert configuration.·       Integrate telemetry from across the security landscape - EDR, network, identity, and CI/CD - into a single correlated view.·       Design, build, and tune data correlation rules and alerting logic across sources, moving away from siloed, single-tool dashboards.·       Maintain the underlying data pipeline (log shippers, aggregation layer, storage, and visualisation).·       Identify and investigate incidents that emerge from correlation across previously disconnected data sources, like EDR alerts tied back to network/identity events.·       Incorporate CI/CD pipeline and supply-chain security signals into the detection platform.·       Conduct security assessments of new tools and third-party platforms prior to integration, with particular regard to data handling and compliance.·       Design the correlation and detection model to be extensible, so new data sources or systems can be onboarded as requirements change, without as little reengineering required.·       Provide technical support during incident response, including direct interrogation of log and event data.·       Maintain technical documentation for the tooling layer to a standard suitable for handover and audit.·       Envisage issues and deployment integrations for an infrastructure as code environment, and knowing when and where the considerations need to be considered. Requirements: ·       3+ years' of hands-on experience with a log aggregation and detection platform (e.g. Elastic Stack, Splunk, Graylog, or comparable), at a level extending beyond dashboard configuration to pipeline design, data management, and query/detection logic.·       Demonstrated experience integrating multiple, disparate telemetry sources, including EDR and network/identity data, into a single correlated platform.·       Understanding of security tooling landscape and best practises and the products in the landscape.·       Strong working knowledge of Linux systems administration, including the ability to script ingestion and transformation logic rather than relying solely on pre-built connectors when required.·       Working understanding of how EDR, firewall, identity, and CI/CD signals differ, and the ability to distinguish baseline from anomalous behaviour across tool types.·       Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Ansible, Terraform) for deployment and maintenance of security tooling.·       Strong GIT and change management systems understanding. jobposting.description: Andersen is hiring a Data Scientist for a project developing a large-scale media intelligence platform and delivering AI-powered audience analytics solutions. The company is a global technology provider delivering data analytics and AI-powered solutions that help organizations better understand customer behavior, optimize marketing performance, and make informed business decisions. By transforming large volumes of data into actionable insights, it enables enterprises to improve audience engagement, measure the effectiveness of their initiatives, and enhance decision-making. The company works with a diverse range of customers, supporting them in navigating an increasingly data-driven and rapidly evolving digital landscape. The project is focused on developing a large-scale media intelligence platform that analyzes consumer engagement across TV, digital, and connected devices. It leverages real-time, consented data to deliver audience insights, content analytics, and data-driven solutions for media and advertising. Responsibilities: - Owning end-to-end delivery of significant data science projects — from problem scoping and approach design through to production deployment. - Making sound, independently-reasoned decisions on methodology, model selection, and evaluation; documenting them clearly in technical solution documents covering problem statement, approach, metrics, and timeline. - Leading solution design for your own initiatives. - Breaking down complex epics into well-scoped user stories with clear acceptance criteria, adopting DataOps and MLOps best practices throughout — experiment tracking, pipeline orchestration, model monitoring, and reproducibility. - Building production-quality Python and PySpark code on Databricks — well-tested, documented, and reusable — and implement advanced ML and AI-powered workflows including entity resolution, probabilistic record linkage, embedding-based matching, semantic similarity, and LLM-augmented pipelines. - Developing and maintaining reusable tools, libraries, and documentation that improve team efficiency and technical standards. - Conducting code reviews with constructive, specific feedback that raises the bar. - Mentoring junior data scientists on technical execution, code quality, and career development. - Leading internal talks or workshops on ML topics. - Collaborating cross-functionally with product, engineering, and operations — translating business requirements into technical specifications, partner with data engineering on scalable pipeline design, and participate in cross-functional design reviews and working groups.  Must-haves: Hands-on experience in Data Science, including ownership of complex, multi-sprint projects for 3+ years. Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field (Master's degree preferred). Advanced proficiency in Python, including writing production-quality, well-tested, and well-documented code. Strong experience with SQL and PySpark, including processing datasets at billion-row scale. Hands-on experience with Databricks, including Workflows, Delta Lake, and job orchestration. Working knowledge of AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Strong foundation in Machine Learning, including regression, classification, clustering, model evaluation, and experimental design. Experience with MLOps practices, including experiment tracking, Airflow-based pipeline orchestration, and reproducible model deployment. Familiarity with modern AI technologies, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LLM-based applications, vector databases, and semantic search. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation, user story creation, and cross-functional collaboration. Level of English – from Intermediate+ and above.  Nice to have: Knowledge graph construction, entity resolution, or semantic data modeling (RDF, OWL, SPARQL, or equivalent). Experience with probabilistic record linkage, identity graph approaches, and embedding-based entity matching at scale. Experience with causal inference methods, including A/B testing, synthetic control, and uplift modeling. Experience with deduplication, data enrichment, or web-to-TV linkage problems. Background in media, ad tech, or measurement specifically: TV viewership (ACR/STB data), digital audience modeling, cross-platform measurement (linear + CTV/OTT), identity resolution in privacy-constrained environments. Familiarity with the measurement/identity vendor landscape: Nielsen, Comscore, LiveRamp, The Trade Desk.  Reasons why this job would be interesting to you: Experience in teamwork with leaders in FinTech, Healthcare, Retail, Telecom, and others. Andersen cooperates with such businesses as Samsung, Siemens, Johnson & Johnson, BNP Paribas, Ryanair, Mercedes, TUI, Verivox, Allianz, T-Systems, etc.. The opportunity to change the project and/or develop expertise in an interesting business domain. Job conditions – you can work both fully remotely and from the office or can choose a hybrid variant. Guarantee of professional, financial, and career growth! The company has introduced systems of mentoring and adaptation for each new employee. The opportunity to earn up to an additional 1,000 EUR per month, depending on the level of expertise, which will be included in the annual bonus, by participating in the company's activities. Access to the corporate training portal, where the entire knowledge base of the company is collected and which is constantly updated. Bright corporate life (parties / pizza days / PlayStation / fruits / coffee / snacks / movies). Certification compensation (AWS, PMP, etc). Referral program. Private health insurance and sports compensation, depending on the type of employment. Your personal data is protected in accordance with GDPR regulations. Learn more: https://andersenlab.com/privacy-policy/pl  Join us!

jobposting.description: Jesteśmy Kodland, międzynarodową szkołą programowania online dla dzieci i młodzieży. Uczymy dzieci w ponad 40 krajach, liczba uczniów przekroczyła 15 000, a liczba profesjonalnych nauczycieli to ponad 700. Programy naszych kursów są opracowywane przez nauczycieli z dużym doświadczeniem zawodowym w dziedzinie informatyki i prowadzone przez wykwalifikowanych instruktorów.Naszym celem jest przekazanie studentom wiedzy na temat poszukiwanych zawodów informatycznych oraz udowodnienie, że komputer może stać się potężnym narzędziem rozwoju osobistego. Kodland szybko się rozwija i poszerza swoją działalność na całym świecie. Obecnie pracujemy na nowych rynkach i poszukujemy profesjonalistów, którzy są gotowi dołączyć się do naszego zespołu.Czego szukamy?Przedstawicieli Handlowych, którzy są odpowiedzialni za prezentację lekcji próbnych o programowaniu poprzez rozmowy na platformie z rodzicami i ich dziećmi.Lekcje te trwają od 40 minut do 1 godziny i polegają na przeprowadzeniu dziecka (w towarzystwie rodzica) przez krótkie, zabawne i praktyczne ćwiczenia programistyczne, które pomogą dziecku rozwinąć umiejętności niezbędne do funkcjonowania we współczesnym świecie.Nie wiesz jak programować? Nie martw się, zapewniamy niezbędne szkolenie!Co sprawia, że jesteś najlepszym kandydatem?Umiejętność budowania dobrego kontaktu z dziećmi i rodzicami.Solidne umiejętności prezentacji. - Musisz być doskonałym komunikatorem.Przyjazne, cierpliwe i profesjonalne usposobienie.Jeśli masz doświadczenie w sprzedaży, obsłudze klienta, nauczaniu, prezentowaniu, szkoleniu lub coachingu, chętnie się z Tobą skontaktujemy.Musisz posiadać komputer/laptop z systemem Windows lub Mac i dobre połączenie z Internetem, aby kwalifikować się do tej roli.Znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie średniozaawansowanym, umożliwiająca komunikację z zespołem Kodland International.Co otrzymasz w zamian?Praca jest całkowicie zdalna - jeśli tylko posiadasz komputer/laptop z kamerką, mikrofonem i stabilnym połączeniem internetowym, możesz pracować z dowolnego miejsca na świecie.Nieograniczoną możliwość rozwoju i promocji.Możliwość pracy z młodymi profesjonalistami w różnych dziedzinach na całym świecie.Zniżki dla pracowników na wszystkie nasze niesamowite produkty dla Twojej rodziny i przyjaciół.Aby dowiedzieć się więcej o nas i stanowisku, kliknij tutaj: https://www.kodland.org/pl/sales-manager

jobposting.description: Who we are At The Stepstone Group, we have a simple yet very important mission: The right job for everyone. With over 20 brands across 30+ countries, we strive for fair and unbiased hiring. At our Tech Hub, located near Wilanowska Metro, we are here as more than 300 ambitious specialists who work on the development of our IT products. We are proud to be part of The Stepstone Group, a global expert in job-tech platforms and e-recruiting. Join our team of 4,000+ employees and be part of reshaping the labour market and becoming the world's leading job-tech platform. The job at a glance Join our Apply domain as a Senior Software Engineer II and take ownership of complex backend challenges built primarily on .NET Core. This is a senior individual contributor role where you will act as a hands-on technical anchor, shaping architectural solutions while building them together with the team. Working in the Apply domain, you will solve ambiguous technical problems with low to moderate supervision, choose or adapt the right approach, and help teams connect engineering solutions back to business needs. You will also mentor less experienced engineers and contribute to technical initiatives that go beyond your immediate team. This is so important to us. By joining our team, you will be playing a vital role as together we reimagine the labour market to make it work for everybody. Your responsibilities Lead technical initiatives within the team and support cross-team engineering efforts. Design and implement architectural solutions, remaining hands-on throughout delivery while ensuring code quality, engineering best practices, and modern software delivery standards. Identify technical risks and optimization opportunities, recommending and justifying the most effective solutions. Mentor and coach engineers, contributing to technical reviews, hiring, and promotion processes. Drive knowledge sharing across the engineering organization through Communities of Practice and communicate technical decisions and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Your skills and qualifications Strong hands-on experience with .NET Core, SQL, AWS, and building scalable microservices/event-driven architectures, including asynchronous communication and message queues. Solid understanding of automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software delivery practices, with experience using or adopting AI-assisted development tools. Proven ability to independently solve complex and ambiguous technical challenges, selecting and adapting the most appropriate solutions. Experience mentoring and coaching engineers, with exposure to technical interviews, promotion reviews, or other engineering talent processes. Self-driven and proactive engineer with excellent judgement, strong ownership mindset, and a track record of contributing to knowledge-sharing initiatives such as Communities of Practice, tech talks, or similar forums. Your benefits We're a community here that cares as much about your life outside work as how you feel when you're with us. Because your job shouldn't take over your life, it should enrich it. Here are some of the benefits we offer: Premium medical and dental care Life insurance Flex Benefits - Worksmile Cafeteria System (Multisport, vouchers, tickets etc.) Employee Referral Program Hackathons, Knowledge Sharing Hours, In-house projects Tech and sport communities Events and integration parties Charity initiatives, 2 extra volunteer days English/German classes Game room and chillout zone Our commitment Equal opportunities are important to us. We believe that diversity and inclusion at The Stepstone Group are critical to our success as a global company, so we want to recruit, develop, and keep the best talent. We encourage applications from everyone, regardless of background, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, ethnicity, belief, age, family or parental status, and any other characteristic.

jobposting.description: About uscomm1t is a specialist IT recruitment agency delivering top engineers across Poland and Europe 🇪🇺. We combine experienced recruiters with autonomous AI agents and an obsessive focus on quality — sourcing 24/7 across LinkedIn, GitHub, and beyond to reach engineers who aren't actively job hunting but are open to the right move.We don't flood you with CVs. We get to know each candidate's skills, values, and goals, then send only the best-matched people — and we stay close through onboarding and the first months to make sure the placement lasts.About the roleYou'll lead the backend that drives the AI features — the APIs, the data pipelines, and the orchestration that connects the product to the language models doing the actual work. In practice that's querying across large document sets, getting trustworthy answers out of LLMs and their tool calls, pushing results to the UI as they stream, and grinding through lengthy background jobs without the whole thing toppling over.Forget CRUD. The real difficulty is making AI systems fast and reliable on confidential data, at production scale. The architecture choices land on you early, and you'll be the one living with them.What you'll doArchitect and ship the APIs and services that everything else depends onOwn the AI plumbing end to end: retrieval, orchestration, tool-calling, streaming, and the evals that tell you whether the results are worth anythingMake async and distributed workloads rock-solid — document ingestion, embeddings, and long jobs running on RedisWire up integrations with what clients already use (email, document stores) and harden them for real-world trafficPut data security and isolation front and center, because clients are handing over material they can't afford to leakWho you areSeven years or more delivering production backends — though how deep you go matters more to us than the figure itselfYou think in failure modes, not just the happy pathYou've shipped genuine LLM systems (RAG, tool-calling, agents), or you can't wait to — and you've got a feel for where they fall apartYou lean on AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) and get real value from them: more speed, yes, but you grasp and back every line — code you'd reject in someone else's review is code you won't merge in your ownA startup that keeps changing course doesn't faze you — plans get set, then torn up and redrawnTech stack experiencePython: 6+ yearsFastAPI: 3+ yearsPostgreSQL / SQLRedis: 2+ yearsNice to haveRAG or vector search experienceLangChain or LlamaIndex

jobposting.description: Job Description:  We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to support the implementation of a centralized and automated e-invoicing solution. The role will focus on gathering business and regulatory requirements, defining future-state processes, and supporting compliance with German B2B e-invoicing regulations, GoBD requirements, multi-VAT scenarios, and future EU ViDA standards. jobposting.description: About uscomm1t is a specialist IT recruitment agency delivering top engineers across Poland and Europe 🇪🇺. We combine experienced recruiters with autonomous AI agents and an obsessive focus on quality — sourcing 24/7 across LinkedIn, GitHub, and beyond to reach engineers who aren't actively job hunting but are open to the right move.We don't flood you with CVs. We get to know each candidate's skills, values, and goals, then send only the best-matched people — and we stay close through onboarding and the first months to make sure the placement lasts.About the roleYou'll lead the backend that drives the AI features — the APIs, the data pipelines, and the orchestration that connects the product to the language models doing the actual work. In practice that's querying across large document sets, getting trustworthy answers out of LLMs and their tool calls, pushing results to the UI as they stream, and grinding through lengthy background jobs without the whole thing toppling over.Forget CRUD. The real difficulty is making AI systems fast and reliable on confidential data, at production scale. The architecture choices land on you early, and you'll be the one living with them.What you'll doArchitect and ship the APIs and services that everything else depends onOwn the AI plumbing end to end: retrieval, orchestration, tool-calling, streaming, and the evals that tell you whether the results are worth anythingMake async and distributed workloads rock-solid — document ingestion, embeddings, and long jobs running on RedisWire up integrations with what clients already use (email, document stores) and harden them for real-world trafficPut data security and isolation front and center, because clients are handing over material they can't afford to leakWho you areSeven years or more delivering production backends — though how deep you go matters more to us than the figure itselfYou think in failure modes, not just the happy pathYou've shipped genuine LLM systems (RAG, tool-calling, agents), or you can't wait to — and you've got a feel for where they fall apartYou lean on AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) and get real value from them: more speed, yes, but you grasp and back every line — code you'd reject in someone else's review is code you won't merge in your ownA startup that keeps changing course doesn't faze you — plans get set, then torn up and redrawnTech stack experiencePython: 6+ yearsFastAPI: 3+ yearsPostgreSQL / SQLRedis: 2+ yearsNice to haveRAG or vector search experienceLangChain or LlamaIndex

jobposting.description: Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end-to-end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.About the role: What's in the BoxThe Consumer Alliance drives customer acquisition, conversion optimization, and retention strategies across all HelloFresh and Ready-to-Eat (RTE) brands globally. The alliance is responsible for cross-cutting initiatives that maximize business value through modernized payment processing, dynamic customer activations and reactivations, and organic growth channels like SEO. By leveraging rigorous experimentation, data-driven insights, and continuous backend modernization, we ensure a frictionless, highly optimized funnel that improves conversion rates and sustains long-term growth across all regions.The Cart & Wallet squad is looking for a Senior React Native Engineer to build and evolve the cart, checkout, and wallet experiences across our mobile and web apps. This is where intent turns into revenue: every change you ship is measured directly in conversion, order value, and customer trust, across all HelloFresh Group's brands and markets, for millions of customers every day, globally.At HelloTech, flexibility and cross-functional collaboration are core to how we work. While this role is aligned to a specific Alliance, strong candidates may also be considered for opportunities across different teams or projects.What you’ll do: The RecipeBuild and improve the cart, checkout, and wallet flows in our React Native apps, from problem definition through to production and measurementRun experiments on high-traffic, revenue-critical surfaces, and use the results to decide what ships nextCollaborate with engineers across the department and the company to continuously improve the code base, systems, and processesDesign and develop solutions that can continue to scaleSupport other team members through workshops, pair programming, and code reviewsWhat you’ll bring: The Ingredients Solid hands-on experience working with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) beyond casual experimentation. You use AI agents as thought partners to onboard on unfamiliar codebases and navigate new areas of the code with confidence. You have a practical sense of how the context you provide to AI tools - specifications, constraints, examples - shapes output quality, and a developing awareness of how agentic outputs can fail, with growing habits around verifying, testing, and setting boundaries on AI-generated work.At least 2-3 years of hands-on work with React NativeA minimum of 5 years of experience working with HTML, CSS, and JavaScriptProficiency in building component-based architectures using React.js and Node.jsDeep understanding of integrating frontend and backend services seamlesslyFamiliarity with CI/CD workflows, along with solid testing practices, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testingStrong collaboration skills when partnering with engineers and other functional roles, like product management and UX designersAbove all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.What we offer: The ToppingsGlobal collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at a global scale, supporting 6+ million customers and complex supply chain operations.Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.Access to the workspace at Warsaw Centre Point. The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).Are you the missing ingredient? jobposting.description: Kierownik Systemów Operacyjnych i InfrastrukturySzukamy osoby, która przejmie odpowiedzialność za systemowe zaplecze naszych operacji magazynowych i e-commerce.To stanowisko dla osoby, która dobrze odnajduje się na styku technologii, logistyki i procesów biznesowych – potrafi zdiagnozować problem, znaleźć jego przyczynę, skoordynować rozwiązanie z dostawcą systemu, a jednocześnie dostrzega możliwości automatyzacji i usprawniania procesów.Nie szukamy programisty ani osoby zarządzającej zespołem magazynowym. Szukamy właściciela funkcjonalnego systemów, który zadba o to, aby technologia rzeczywiście wspierała skalowanie naszych operacji.Twoje główne zadania1. Systemy operacyjne – WMS / OMS / LinkerBędziesz odpowiadać za funkcjonalną stronę systemów wspierających nasze operacje, w szczególności za:konfigurację systemów, zmian, dostępów i uprawnień,utrzymanie i rozwój integracji,koordynowanie wdrażania aktualizacji i zmian systemowych,przygotowanie i realizację testów przed wdrożeniem,analizę wpływu zmian na procesy magazynowe,diagnozowanie incydentów oraz koordynowanie ich rozwiązania z dostawcami systemów,komunikowanie statusu problemów i zmian właścicielom procesów,dbanie o jakość i kompletność danych systemowych, w tym danych wykorzystywanych do rozliczeń klientów.Za rozwój oprogramowania i jego techniczną stabilność odpowiadają dostawcy systemów – Twoją rolą będzie diagnoza, konfiguracja, koordynacja i doprowadzenie tematów do rozwiązania.2. Usprawnianie i automatyzacja procesówZależy nam na osobie, która nie ogranicza się do reagowania na zgłoszenia.Będziesz:analizować sposób wykorzystania systemów w codziennych operacjach,identyfikować czynności wykonywane ręcznie lub poza systemem,wyszukiwać wąskie gardła i źródła nieefektywności,rekomendować zmiany w konfiguracji i workflow,wdrażać zaakceptowane usprawnienia,wykorzystywać dane systemowe do wspierania decyzji operacyjnych i biznesowych.Celem jest ograniczanie pracy manualnej, upraszczanie procesów i zwiększanie wydajności magazynu poprzez właściwe wykorzystanie systemów.3. Integracje e-commerce i wdrożenia klientówBędziesz odpowiadać za systemową stronę integracji z klientami i partnerami:konfigurację i utrzymanie integracji ze sklepami internetowymi, marketplace'ami i systemami zewnętrznymi,nadzór nad synchronizacją stanów magazynowych,analizę i wyjaśnianie rozbieżności systemowych,systemowe wdrażanie nowych klientów,wsparcie koordynatorów w rozwiązywaniu problemów systemowych klientów,udział w spotkaniach z klientami jako ekspert w zakresie systemów i integracji,merytoryczne wsparcie sprzedaży w rozmowach wymagających wiedzy systemowej.4. Rozwój WMS i projekty systemoweW przypadku decyzji o zmianie WMS będziesz aktywnie uczestniczyć w całym procesie jego wyboru i przygotowania do wdrożenia.Do Twoich zadań będzie należeć:współtworzenie wymagań biznesowych i operacyjnych,przygotowanie scenariuszy testowych,prowadzenie testów – również bezpośrednio na hali magazynowej,analiza wyników,identyfikowanie ryzyk,porównywanie rozwiązań,przygotowanie rekomendacji techniczno-procesowej.5. Ciągłość operacyjna i infrastrukturaUzupełniającym obszarem odpowiedzialności będzie zapewnienie ciągłości działania operacji od strony infrastrukturalnej i logistycznej, w tym:koordynacja operacyjno-techniczna współpracy z firmami kurierskimi,konfiguracja nowych przewoźników i kanałów kurierskich w systemach,koordynowanie prac serwisowych dotyczących infrastruktury magazynowej,pilnowanie terminów przeglądów i wymaganej dokumentacji, m.in. UDT i PPOŻ,formalna koordynacja tematów BHP oraz kontroli,planowanie zapotrzebowania na materiały operacyjne i monitorowanie ich dostępności,monitorowanie kosztów w powierzonym obszarze i odpowiednio wczesne sygnalizowanie ryzyk.Kogo szukamy?Szukamy osoby, która:ma doświadczenie w pracy z systemami WMS, OMS lub innymi systemami wspierającymi logistykę, fulfillment albo e-commerce,rozumie procesy magazynowe i zależności pomiędzy systemem a fizyczną realizacją operacji,ma doświadczenie w konfiguracji systemów, integracjach lub wdrażaniu zmian systemowych,potrafi przygotować i przeprowadzić testy nowych rozwiązań,potrafi diagnozować problemy i skutecznie współpracować z zewnętrznymi dostawcami IT,umie analizować proces i szukać jego usprawnień,swobodnie pracuje z danymi i raportami,potrafi prowadzić kilka równoległych tematów i doprowadzać je do zamknięcia,potrafi komunikować zagadnienia techniczne osobom biznesowym i operacyjnym,działa proaktywnie – zauważa problem, diagnozuje go i przychodzi z rekomendacją rozwiązania.Mile widzianeDodatkowym atutem będzie:doświadczenie w branży e-commerce, fulfillment lub logistyce kontraktowej,udział we wdrożeniu lub zmianie systemu WMS,doświadczenie w integracjach sklepów internetowych i marketplace'ów,znajomość procesów kurierskich,doświadczenie w automatyzacji procesów operacyjnych.Co będzie Twoim głównym celem?Przygotowujemy nasze systemy i infrastrukturę do sprawnej obsługi 100 000 paczek miesięcznie.Chcemy, aby wraz ze wzrostem skali operacji nie rosła liczba ręcznych czynności, wyjątków i problemów wymagających interwencji.Dlatego szukamy osoby, która pomoże nam zbudować środowisko, w którym systemy są stabilne, integracje przewidywalne, zmiany bezpiecznie testowane, dane wiarygodne, a kolejne procesy automatyzowane i upraszczane.Jeśli lubisz łączyć technologię z procesami i chcesz mieć realny wpływ na sposób działania rozwijającej się operacji e-commerce – zapraszamy do rozmowy.

jobposting.description: INGENIOUS.BUILD is building the operating system for construction and real estate development. We work with some of the largest organizations in the world, and the features our engineers build help teams manage some of the biggest investments being made today. If we succeed, a large share of the world's important infrastructure will be planned, built, and reported on through our platform.We're a product-driven engineering organization. Engineers here don't just take tickets. They understand the customer, challenge proposed solutions, and shape what gets built. We're also going all-in on AI. We treat it as a way to deliver more value to customers, not just to write code faster.About the roleWe're looking for a Developer Team Lead to lead one of our web product teams. This is a small, senior, highly autonomous team. You won't be supervising juniors. You'll be a partner to experienced engineers: bringing the team together, building the right processes, and keeping the team efficient, aligned, and focused on the right problems.The role combines hands-on engineering and leadership. You'll write code, make architectural decisions, and lead the team's AI adoption, while also owning people management, planning, and prioritization. You'll report directly to the Engineering Director. You'll work closely with a Product Manager and a dedicated Product Designer, and alongside other team leads and our DevOps team.What you'll doLead the teamRun regular 1:1s, monitor performance, and support each engineer's growth, including compensation and career conversations.Own the team's high-level planning and prioritization, together with Product and Design.Build and improve the processes that keep a senior team synchronized and effective, without adding bureaucracy.Take part in hiring, onboarding, and performance reviews.Drive AI adoptionLead the AI transformation in your team. Set the pace instead of waiting for it to be defined for you.Go beyond basic prompting. Use AI to research unfamiliar systems, identify gaps, automate repetitive work, and speed up delivery.Experiment with new tools and workflows, standardize what works, and share it with your team and across engineering.Look for ways AI can deliver business value: lower costs, shorter delivery times, higher quality, and solutions that weren't practical before.Build the productStay hands-on: write code, review code, and own the technical direction of your team's modules.Make sound architectural decisions in a large modular monolith.Use customer insights to challenge solutions, propose improvements, and help decide what to build and in what order.Keep improving the codebase by reducing legacy code, adding tests, and keeping dependencies current.Our tech and engineering approachStack: PHP 8.5, Laravel 13, PostgreSQLArchitecture: a large modular monolith. Modules communicate through facades, adapters, or events, which keeps boundaries clear. More complex modules use DDD.Philosophy: code that's easy to test and reason about. Business logic lives in clear PHP classes, separate from the framework, with no 'magic.'Quality: pipelines with PHPStan, PHPCS, and unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, all supporting automatic deployments. DevOps owns infrastructure, so you can focus on building.AI tooling: Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and whatever else helps us move faster. We revisit our tools regularly because they improve quickly.What we're looking forMust-havesPeople management experience. You've already led developers, including 1:1s, performance, and team processes. This isn't a first step into management.Strong backend engineering. Advanced PHP 8.1+ with Laravel or Symfony, and experience building large, scalable applications.Technical leadership and architecture. You've led the technical side of complex projects: making design decisions, not just carrying them out.Hands-on AI adoption. You already use AI tools in your daily engineering work and are excited to push further. You don't need deep AI expertise, but you do need the energy to lead this.Product mindset. You care about the 'why,' think about business impact, and want to shape solutions, not just implement specs.Testing. Solid experience with PHPUnit and a good testing strategy across unit, integration, and functional tests.English at B2 level or higher.Nice-to-havesExperience with modular monoliths (microservices experience also counts)Practical experience with Domain-Driven DesignBackground in SaaS, especially large systems like ERP, CRM, or CMSExperience in startups or scale-ups where engineers work directly with product decisionsThe kind of person who thrives hereCurious. You enjoy learning, and you revisit your opinions as tools and practices change.Proactive. You spot problems and opportunities and act on them. You can point to improvements you proposed that were adopted.Driven. You have the grit to take on hard problems and want to be part of something that could reshape an industry.A partner. Senior engineers respect you because you support them, not because you manage them closely.What we offerStock options, so you share in the company's growthFlexible working hours and a minimal-meetings cultureUnlimited PTOA high-performance company laptopOne-time $500 budget to set up your workspace$50 per month for education, rolling over until year-endLicenses for Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and PhpStor

jobposting.description: RavenDB is a high-performance, transactional NoSQL document database running in production at companies worldwide, with a fully managed cloud (DBaaS) offering. We're an established, fast-growing and engineering-led company and we are currently looking for Software Engineer - RavenDB Support.You will investigate complex production issues, reverse-engineer failures, analyze distributed system behavior, and dive deep into C# internals to uncover root causes. Success in this role is measured not only by solving today's hardest problems, but by reducing the number of hard problems that reach support tomorrow. You will work closely with customers, developers, and product teams to turn insights from the field into lasting improvements across the organization. Key Responsibilities:Investigate & Diagnose: Tackle complex customer issues across RavenDB clusters, from log forensics to source-code-level root cause analysis.Log Forensics: Analyze large-scale distributed system logs to reconstruct incident timelines and draw definitive conclusions.Code-Level Debugging: Read and reason through C#/.NET internals to identify bugs, propose fixes and produce actionable bug reports for the core dev team.Technical Communication: Translate complex technical findings into clear, structured, and professional written explanations for clients.Broad Ownership: Handle a wide technical surface across the database ecosystem, including replication, indexing, memory management, ETL, backups, and client integrations.Navigate Ambiguity: Work independently on complex problems where the answer isn’t obvious, the evidence is incomplete, and you must decide when to escalate vs. when to call a theory confirmed.Customer Partnership: Work directly with customers to understand both the technical and business impact of issues, set expectations, communicate progress and guide investigations to successful outcomes. Process & Tooling Improvements: Identify recurring support challenges and proactively improve workflows, tooling, diagnostics, documentation, and automation to reduce resolution times and improve customer experience. Knowledge Sharing: Build and maintain internal knowledge, troubleshooting guides, postmortems, and best practices that enable the entire team to operate more effectively. What We’re Looking For:Strong proficiency in C# and the .NET ecosystem (specifically understanding memory management, async programming, and concurrency) - 5+ years of experienceExperience with distributed systems concepts (replication, consensus, networking).A 'detective' mindset - someone who loves reading logs and tracking down elusive edge cases.Strong customer orientation with the ability to understand both the technical and business impact of an issue, ensuring customers receive the optimal solution within the appropriate timeframe.Excellent communication skills, capable of translating complex technical findings into clear, structured, and professional explanations for customers while setting accurate expectations and guiding them through the investigation process.A strong sense of urgency, ownership, and accountability, with the ability to prioritize effectively, make sound judgment calls, and drive issues to resolution without sacrificing technical quality.A proactive improvement mindset - someone who looks beyond individual issues, identifies recurring patterns and drives improvements in tooling, automation, documentation and processes.The ability to work independently on complex problems where evidence may be incomplete, balancing investigative depth with timely customer outcomes and knowing when to escalate versus when to confidently conclude an investigation.

jobposting.description: About the job: Massive Scale: Design, build, and optimize systems that handle a huge distributed scale of ~120 million offer events daily. You will be working on one of the largest services at Allegro.Applied AI & Machine Learning: Move beyond simple chatbots. You will work with real AI use cases, integrating ML models and AI agents to analyze images (e.g., detecting counterfeit products and supporting brand protection processes) and read the context of offers to make automated decisions.Meaningful Business Impact: Build and maintain essential tools that ensure platform safety and compliance. Your work in automating offer and product verification will directly prevent legal and Terms & Conditions breaches and protect users.Modern Tech Stack: Work primarily in Kotlin to build our backend services. While the backend is our core, having an interest in frontend technologies (like React, Angular, or Vue.js) is a great plus, as we value full-stack capabilities.Cutting-Edge AI Infrastructure: Be part of the initiative to evaluate and build infrastructure for open-source AI models (open weights) to optimize costs. You will also help develop 'AI Evals' to track model performance and prevent regressions at scale. Join the Offer Verification team! You will have a chance to build tools that validate all merchant listings against the company policies and law regulations. Your team works with the Data Science and Machine Learning teams, utilizing AI to make real-time decisions. High performance, engineering best practices, and a great atmosphere in the team guaranteed!Important things for you: Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.The salary range for this position depending on the skill set is as follows (contract of employment, tax-deductible cost):PLN PLN 14 600 - 20 825 Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.Our team is based in Warsaw.We are looking for people who:Have commercial experience coding in Kotlin or Java (with an eagerness to master Kotlin for our new services);Value high-quality code and engineering best practices to solve complex challenges in massive-scale distributed systems;Are excited to implement and optimize AI models in a production environment;Embrace a growth mindset, value team stability, and are open to occasionally picking up frontend tasks (React is a nice-to-have);Communicate effectively in English (at least a B2 level).What’s in it for you:Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).A 16' or 14' MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories.A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings. An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal. Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy.And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here.#goodtobehere means that:You will join a team you can count on - we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA.You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.You will value our Developer Experience and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Thanks to this, you can contribute to Allegro from your very first days on the job. You will be equipped with modern AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on developing new services and refining existing ones (also leveraging AI support).You will create solutions that will be used (and loved!) by your friends, family and millions of our customers.You will meet the Allegro Scale, which starts with over 1000 microservices, an open-source data bus (Hermes) with 300K+ rps, a Service Mesh with 1M+ rps, tens of petabytes of data, and production-used machine learning. You will become part of Allegro Tech - We speak at industry conferences, cooperate with tech communities, run our own blog (it's been over 10 years!), record podcasts, lead guilds, and we organize our own internal conference - the Allegro Tech Meeting. We create solutions we love (and can) to talk about!Send us your CV and… see you at Allegro!

jobposting.description: In shortAs our Senior UI Designer, you'll shape how people interact with real, physical devices: the app that pairs with a smart ring, the interface that controls high-end speakers, the screen that shows your heart rate live. Your designs won't end up in a drawer; you'll take them from the first client workshop all the way to production, working with international startups, scale-ups, and enterprise clients, side by side with a world-class UX team and developers who genuinely care about design. It's a permanent, full-time role: fixed monthly salary and full benefits from day one.Why intent?We've been designing and co-creating connected devices since 2008: wearables, smart audio, and health-tech hardware for clients like Oura, BOSE, and McIntosh, backed by investors like a16z and Founders Fund. We're 60+ people, fully remote, and we've been AI-native since before LinkedIn influencers discovered the term. If you've ever designed a pairing flow and felt weirdly proud when the LED actually blinked, you already get why we love what we do.Who this role is NOT forWho this role is NOT forIf most of your portfolio consists of websites, branding, or UX work, this probably isn’t the right role for you. We’re looking for a strong visual designer who has meaningfully contributed to at least four commercial iOS or Android apps and can turn wireframes into distinctive, polished interfaces.This role also won’t suit someone who waits for fully defined requirements or a daily list of tickets. You should be comfortable starting from a loose brief, making sensible assumptions, and owning the visual direction from the first workshop through to production.What you'll doConduct UI direction workshops that turn the client’s vision, benchmarks, and often loosely defined brand, sometimes limited to a logo, colors, and typography, into a clear direction for the product UI. Guide clients in translating and scaling their brand personality into the digital world, showing how it can come to life in a mobile app in a way that feels distinctive and engaging, while remaining accessible and easy to use.Create design system, high-fidelity mockups, micro-animations, and prototypes for new and existing products and features, mostly native iOS and Android appsDesign interfaces where software meets hardware: pairing flows, device status, sensor data visualizationSupport projects from initial design to final production, in close collaboration with developers, QA, and PMsHelp implement and develop our branding, and create graphic materials that strengthen our recognition across digital channels.Push and experiment with new ideas, trends, and tools, and turn the good ones into team standardsShare knowledge within and outside of intent: chapter sessions, tech talks, the design communityUse AI tools as part of your daily workflow, not as a party trick.What we're looking for4+ years of commercial UI design experience, including substantial hands-on work on at least four native mobile app projects. This is a mobile-first role, so web-only experience or a single mobile project won’t be sufficient.Advanced Figma skills: design systems built on components and auto-layouts, and files other designers can actually navigateHands-on experience designing interfaces for IoT and connected devices (not 'I read about it once')A broad portfolio of visually rich work you're proud to walk us throughSolid knowledge of Apple's Human Interface Guidelines and Android platform guidelines, paired with a real passion for mobile technologySome experience with motion and animation, not only static screensA strong aesthetic sense and the ambition to create beautiful, useful apps, not just boring screens.Very good English (C1), because our clients are mostly US-basedConfidence presenting designs to clients and explaining your decisions; joining pre-sales calls with potential clients doesn't scare youInitiative, ownership, and the kind of communication where people don't have to guess what you meant.Nice to haveExperience designing for wearables, health-tech, or smart audioThe basics of Photoshop and IllustratorMotion design tools: After Effects, Rive, Lottie, or similarHow we workFully remote with an office in Warsaw if walls and coffee machines motivate you, but nobody will ask why you're not there. Working hours are flexible: most of the team operates between 10:00 and 18:00 CET, and that's when most meetings happen. Evening calls with US-based clients (up to ~20:00) are part of the rhythm, sometimes a couple of times a week, always planned ahead. You'll be part of the UX/UI Design chapter for knowledge-sharing and growth, and simultaneously on a project squad led by a PM for day-to-day delivery, working alongside mobile and firmware engineers, QA, and UX designers.What you'll get15,500-22,000 PLN net/month on B2B, depending on your experience26 days of paid leave10 days of paid sick leaveSaltus medical careTraining budgetTruly flexible hours: you organize your own dayYour first weeksWe aim to give you space to ramp up before jumping into live project work, but this is a real company with real deadlines: if a project needs you sooner, we'll make sure you have the support to hit the ground running. You'll get paired with a buddy from the design team and take on progressively bigger tasks so both sides can see how the collaboration feels. Feedback comes early and often; no one waits three months to tell you something isn't working. We believe in fast, honest signals: if it's great, you'll know. If something needs adjusting, you'll hear about it while there's still time to adjust.Recruitment processThe entire process is in English. All interviews are recorded for internal evaluation purposes.Application with a few screening questions and your portfolioPortfolio reviewHR call (~45 min, casual)Technical interview (30-60 min, with the design team)Final feedbackOnce we're in touch, you'll hear from us fast. We don't ghost and we don't drag.intent is an equal opportunity employer. We care about what you can do, not where you come from. Send us your CV, your portfolio, and a few words about why this caught your eye. Bonus points if you point us to the project you're most proud of and tell us why.

jobposting.description: Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.About the role: What's in the BoxThe Foundations Alliance's mission is to accelerate the delivery of high-quality, scalable, and highly available digital products at HelloFresh by providing services and platforms that improve internal builder productivity and system reliability. This position is for a Senior Product Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the Operational Data Platform—the systems that create, transport, and store data at the point of origin, making it available for downstream analytics or AI. The role holds accountability for a high-leverage layer of the data ecosystem: the streaming and database infrastructure that product engineering teams rely on to get data flowing reliably.The core objective is to ensure operational data is created, delivered, and shared downstream reliably, cost-efficiently, and with explicit quality guarantees. The service provider will define the roadmap for the squad's platform (event streaming, relational, and NoSQL databases), partner closely with the Engineering Lead for the Operational Data Platform, and collaborate cross-functionally with data producer and analytical teams. This engagement comes at a key moment for critical-path cost-efficiency and reliability initiatives. This role does not include people management responsibilities.At HelloTech, flexibility and cross-functional collaboration are core to how we work. While this role is aligned to a specific Alliance, strong candidates may also be considered for opportunities across different teams or projects.What you’ll do: The RecipeDrive the product vision and roadmap for the Operational Data Platform—focusing on low-latency data creation, transport, storage, and availability for downstream analytics—partnering closely with the Engineering Lead for the platform.Lead the squad's cost-efficiency roadmap, taking accountability for targeted cost savings as a core KPI.Maintain the reliability of critical-path systems (streaming and core databases), setting uptime targets and feeding incident learnings back into platform planning.Champion data-contract and schema standards at the point of data creation, collaborating with data-producing engineering teams to close adoption gaps and ensure quality data flows downstream.Guide platform tooling decisions, consolidating technologies around optimal solutions rather than accumulating redundant options.Define and maintain the handover contract with the Analytical Data Platform, ensuring downstream data is consistently trustworthy and ready for governance.Act as the primary interface between the Operational Data Platform and data producers, translating business and technical needs into actionable roadmap priorities.Define, track, and report squad KPIs (cost efficiency, critical-path reliability, data-quality adoption) against quarterly alliance goals.What you’ll bring: The Ingredients Proven experience as a Product Manager with a solid grounding in data infrastructure, data engineering, or backend platforms—comfortable with streaming, messaging, and database architecture.Working familiarity with event streaming and relational/NoSQL database technologies to partner credibly with engineering leads on technical trade-offs.Track record of driving roadmaps and KPIs for technical teams in platform problem spaces, managing metrics like cost, reliability, or data quality to target.Data-driven approach to prioritization and roadmap decisions, supported by analytical tools and frameworks.Strong collaboration and communication capabilities to establish trust and technical alignment with engineering leads and key stakeholders.Pragmatic, execution-oriented mindset to drive day-to-day delivery autonomously and navigate cost, reliability, and technical debt trade-offs in live production environments. Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.What we offer: The ToppingsGlobal collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point. The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you.  We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.#PRODUCT

twardych dowodach.Nadzór nad środowiskami budowy agentów: Integracja i kontrola nad platformami Copilot Studio oraz Azure AI Foundry, a także projektowanie cross-platformowego rejestru dla rozwiązań jobposting.description: We are looking for an experienced AWS Cloud Architect / Technical Lead to join an international team developing a business-critical cloud platform.The platform integrates external systems and data sources with cloud-based applications and is currently entering an important phase of its development. jobposting.description: About First ConnectFirst Connect Insurance Services is a digital marketplace providing independent insurance agents access to top US carriers and the optionality necessary to grow their businesses. Agents can work with 150+ carriers, selling various insurance policies, including home, auto, small business, and more. We're on a mission to overhaul the technology agents have access to, putting consumer-grade software at their fingertips. We've got thousands of active agents with hundreds joining monthly, and we plan to accelerate our growth.Role OverviewFirst Connect is fully cloud-native — no offices, no data centers, everything we run lives in the cloud and ships through our pipelines. That makes cloud and infrastructure security the center of gravity for our whole security program, and it's the part of the program we are building right now.This is a hands-on engineering role and most of what you own will be implemented, configured and tuned from scratch rather than inherited: cloud security posture and workload protection, infrastructure and IaC guardrails, automation that removes manual security work, and the emerging practice around how we secure both our internal use of AI and the AI capabilities in our product and development. You'll also help us keep our security engineering aligned with our SOC 2 Type II and financial-services regulatory obligations.You'll join our team as our first dedicated Cloud Security Engineer, reporting directly to our Information Security Manager, and working side by side with our DevOps and R&D teams in Poland, Israel and the US.What You'll Do: Secure and harden our cloud estate: Own the security posture of our AWS environment (identity and access, network boundaries, encryption and key management). Build security into how our infrastructure is defined and deployed: Terraform modules and guardrails, Kubernetes and ECS workloads, container images, secrets management and policy-as-code.Stand up security tooling and detection: Help select, deploy and fine-tune cloud security platforms (CNAPP/CSPM, workload protection, logging and detection), mostly starting from a blank slate. Make sure our telemetry has the right sources, coverage and alerts, and support investigations when something looks wrong.Embed and automate security in delivery: Build SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC and container scanning into our pipelines, cut the noise, and partner with developers on fixing what matters. Treat manual security effort as a bug: findings become tickets, checks become gates, and evidence collects itself.Secure AI across the company and our product: Help the company adopt AI safely by reviewing tools and connectors, mapping data flows, and controlling prompt injection, data exposure and over-permissioned integrations. Work with R&D on the AI capabilities we ship to agents, from threat modeling to controls and monitoring. Support the AI code factory: Review, advise on and help set up fully automated AI code deployment and product development.Be the go-to expert: Act as the technical reference point for cloud security across R&D and DevOps. Review designs, give clear guidance, and make the secure path the easy path.What you'll bringExperience: 6+ years across cloud/infrastructure engineering and information security, with substantial hands-on time in cloud security.AWS and infrastructure depth: You've secured real production AWS environments (IAM and organization-level controls, networking, encryption, logging) and can explain the trade-offs you made. You also have solid production experience with Terraform and Kubernetes and/or ECS.A builder's mindset: You've implemented security tooling from scratch, which means you chose it, rolled it out, tuned it and lived with the results. You drive the technical direction while making decisions together with Security and R&D leadership, and you prefer teamwork to lone-wolf security.Communication and languages: You communicate clearly, in writing and in speech, with DevOps, R&D and non-technical stakeholders across three countries and several time zones.
