jobposting.description: Manager, Engineering (Payouts & Banking Integration)Location: Poznań, PL, 61-569Company:  Allegro Finance sp. z o.o.Team:  TechnologyContract Type:  EmployeeAbout the job:Are you excited about leading high-scale backend engineering in the core fintech sector? Allegro Finance is searching for a dynamic Engineering Manager to lead our Payouts & Banking Integration team. You will be leading a dedicated team of 6 software engineers, driving the core money-out movement and compliance systems of Poland's dominant e-commerce payment platform. Here's why you should join us:High-Impact Domain: Work at the ultimate execution layer of Allegro Finance. Your team owns the critical systems that move billions of PLN from internal ledgers out into the physical banking system. Every delay or error here has direct financial and reputational impacts on our sellers and our license as a Krajowa Instytucja Płatnicza (KIP).Fintech & Compliance Innovation: Drive critical initiatives at the intersection of complex banking rails and regulatory requirements. Your team will build, optimize, and secure automated payout orchestration, real-time sanctions screening, multi-currency foreign exchange pipelines, and legally mandated court-ordered bailiff seizure mechanisms.Deep Technical Integrity: Develop mission-critical operations with strict recovery, zero-data-loss, and high-availability guarantees. Important things for you:Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) — working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.Depending on your annual assessment and the company's results we offer:Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.Long term discretionary incentive plan based on Allegro.eu shares (restricted stock units).Our team is based in Poznań. In your daily work, you will handle the following tasks: Managing, mentoring, and supporting an engineering team of 6 backend developers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, absolute financial precision, and ownership.Overseeing the development of the core payouts engine including banking connectivity (mBank/PKO BP/PayU via SOAP/REST), automated bundling strategies, and ISO 20022/CAMT statement parsers.Collaborating closely with Compliance, Legal, and Finance stakeholders to ensure payouts and legal holds (seizures, blockades) are executed with 100% regulatory compliance and audit readiness.Guiding architectural decisions across the stack — from our high-throughput Kotlin and Spring Boot APIs, reactive messaging pipelines (Azure Service Bus), to MongoDB/PostgreSQL optimizations.Supporting the team in daily operations, optimizing SLA monitoring, resolving production incidents, and ensuring robust, transactional delivery of money-movement software. We are looking for people who:Are experienced leaders who have successfully managed, mentored, and grown backend-focused engineering teams in transactional, high-availability environments.Possess a strong technical background with deep expertise in JVM backend architectures (Kotlin/Java) and remain hands-on when necessary.Demonstrate a solid understanding of financial/fintech systems, including asynchronous message buses (RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus), database transaction isolation, and secure, signed communications.Have a product-oriented mindset focused on financial integrity — understanding that an un-reconciled cent or a stuck bank transfer directly translates to a merchant support ticket and risk exposure.Are proactive collaborators who thrive in an autonomous, leadership-heavy engineering culture, working closely with other core teams (Wallets, Fraud, Verification) to design clean integration boundaries.Are fluent in Polish and have a good command of English. What's in it for you:Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.Long term discretionary incentive plan based on Allegro.eu shares (restricted stock units).Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).A 16' or 14' MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories.A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings.An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal.Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy. And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here. #goodtobehere means that: You will join a team you can count on - we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA.You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.You will value our Developer Experience and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Thanks to this, you can contribute to Allegro from your very first days on the job.You will be equipped with modern AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on developing new services and refining existing ones (also leveraging AI support).You will create solutions that will be used (and loved!) by your friends, family and millions of our customers.You will meet the Allegro Scale, which starts with over 1000 microservices, an open-source data bus (Hermes) with 300K+ rps, a Service Mesh with 1M+ rps, tens of petabytes of data, and production-used machine learning.You will become part of Allegro Tech - we speak at industry conferences, cooperate with tech communities, run our own blog (it's been over 10 years!), record podcasts, lead guilds, and we organize our own internal conference - the Allegro Tech Meeting. We create solutions we love (and can) to talk about! Send us your CV and... see you at Allegro!

jobposting.description: Who we are looking for?Solutions Architects form a guild that provides end-to-end architectural coverage across our systems and customer journey steps. Each Architect owns a defined slice — a system (e.g., search, booking, payments) or a journey step (e.g., checkout, post-booking) — and is the named technical authority for that area. Together, the guild ensures every critical part of our estate is owned, coherent, and moving toward a clear target state.This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will set architectural direction, make and document decisions, and ensure those decisions are understood and adopted in practice — not just written down. Key responsibilities:​Own the end-to-end architecture of an assigned system or customer journey step — maintain a current-state assessment, a target architecture, and a sequenced, costed roadmap between them.Produce and keep current all architectural documentation for the slice: C4 models (L1/L2), Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), ERDs, and sequence diagrams. Every material decision has a written rationale; undocumented architecture does not count.Sit on the Architecture Board as the named decision authority for the slice — assess incoming proposals, drive decisions proactively, surface cross-slice conflicts, and escalate choices with material cost or strategic impact.Lead vendor and technology evaluations; validate team proposals against the target architecture; recommend or block technology choices within the slice with documented rationale. Escalate major changes (new language, cloud provider, database engine, or TCO > €50k over 3 years) to the CTO.Treat AI as a default design ingredient — evaluate where AI patterns (copilots, agentic workflows, RAG, model-backed features) create leverage, drive their adoption, and maintain a clear inventory of AI components and their risk profiles. Ensure AI usage converges on sanctioned patterns and guardrails.Engage directly with product, commercial, and operations stakeholders to discover business intent before design begins. Translate business problems into technical requirements and trade-off frames — design for outcomes, not for tickets.Own and enforce engineering standards within the slice (API design, observability, security baselines, data handling, AI usage); serve as named DRI for at least one standard across the guild. Contribute reusable patterns and golden paths back to the wider engineering organisation.Define SLIs and SLOs for the slice, review breach trends, and partner with Engineering Managers on quarterly reliability improvement goals.Coordinate with adjacent Architects to eliminate seams, duplication, and integration debt across slices. Pair on cross-slice initiatives by default.Actively teach architectural patterns, engineering standards, and AI guidelines across the organisation — and measure adoption, not just publication.Provide technology and design input to Engineering Managers and teams on architecture decisions, integration patterns, and major refactors. Does not own delivery timelines, headcount, sprint planning, or on-call rotations — those remain with Engineering Management.Requirements:8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in an architecture or principal engineering role spanning multiple teams or systems.Proven track record of owning end-to-end architecture for cross-cutting or platform domains — infrastructure, observability, developer platforms, shared services, or similar.Deep experience designing and evolving distributed systems at scale: service boundaries, integration patterns, event-driven architectures, and API design.Ability to produce and maintain living architectural documentation — C4 models, ADRs, ERDs, sequence diagrams — and hold others to the same standard.Experience defining and enforcing engineering standards across multiple teams, with measurable adoption outcomes rather than just published guidelines.Demonstrable ability to engage non-technical stakeholders — product, commercial, operations — and translate business intent into concrete technical requirements and trade-offs.Strong communication and influencing skills: able to drive architectural decisions through persuasion and documented rationale, without direct line authority over engineers.Comfort operating in a governed, multi-team environment — experienced with Architecture Boards, decision escalation paths, and structured ADR practices.Familiarity with modern frontend architecture patterns, including React, SSR, Next.js, and Backend for Frontend (BFF), sufficient to assess design decisions and engage credibly with frontend teams. Nice to have: Experience working within or adapting scaled agile frameworks (SAFe, LeSS, or similar) in a principal engineering or architect capacity.Hands-on experience designing or productionising AI/ML systems — LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, or model evaluation frameworks.Familiarity with travel, e-commerce, or marketplace platform architectures — particularly search, booking, or payments domains.Experience building or operating internal developer platforms, golden paths, or shared engineering toolchains adopted across a large engineering organisation.Background contributing to or maintaining a technology radar, vendor evaluation frameworks, or organisation-wide engineering standards programmes.Experience defining and operationalising SLOs at the platform level, including instrumentation, alerting, and reliability review cadences.

jobposting.description: Get to know us betterCodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:Act to deliver.Disrupt to grow.Team up to win.The project and the teamYou will work on a large-scale, multi-tenant B2B commercial execution platform used by enterprise go-to-market teams. It combines cloud software, capability benchmarking and advanced analytics to turn commercial strategy into measurable action - from account planning and partner management to pricing and sales performance.This is a backend-focused Software Engineering role with a strong AI component. You'll build and operate the Python services behind the platform - APIs, data access, background processing - and you'll design and integrate the generative AI capabilities that sit on top of them: connecting LLMs with the platform's enterprise data, APIs and internal tools through prompt design, tool calling, workflow orchestration, guardrails and human review, all instrumented so that quality, latency and cost are measurable rather than assumed.Daily use of AI development tools is part of how the whole team works, not an add-on. You're expected to use assistants like Claude Code across coding, testing, debugging and code review - and to validate everything they produce before it reaches production.You'll be in regular, direct contact with product managers, designers and client-facing stakeholders, and you'll collaborate with a dedicated team of data scientists on the platform's harder analytical challenges: you own the product integration layer, they own the deeper modelling work. Security runs through everything. This is a multi-tenant SaaS platform handling sensitive enterprise client data, so every service you ship needs to respect tenant isolation, role-based access control and least-privilege data access - across the API, data and AI workflow layers.Technology stack:Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, REST, pytestData: SQL, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy/async drivers, Snowflake, RedisCloud & DevOps: Azure / AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub ActionsAI: LLM APIs, prompt engineering, tool/function calling, LangChain/LangGraph, RAG, vector search (pgvector, Pinecone)AI-assisted Development: Claude Code, CodexAI observability & MLOps: LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetryAuthentication & Security: OAuth 2.0, Okta, JWT, RBACReal-Time & Messaging: Temporal, Socket.IO / WebSocketsWhat else you should know:Team: Product Managers, UX Designers, Fullstack Engineers, Data Engineers, DevOps Engineers, AI Engineers, Data ScientistsYou own the product-facing AI integration layer; deeper ML and data-science work is handled by dedicated specialists you collaborate withAI-augmented development is a core expectation of the role, not optional - daily use of tools like Claude Code or Codex across coding, testing, debugging, and code reviewMulti-tenant SaaS platform handling sensitive enterprise client data - a security-first mindset is expected at every layerAgile, collaborative, impact-driven environment with close cooperation with business and client-facing stakeholdersStrong ownership culture and product mindsetWe work on multiple interesting projects at a time, so it may happen that we’ll invite you to an interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well suited for it.Your roleAs a part of the project team, you will be responsible for:Designing, building, testing and operating production Python services with FastAPI - endpoint design, data validation with Pydantic, auth, error handling and observabilityWriting and optimizing SQL against PostgreSQL and contributing to schema and data-model decisionsDeploying and running services on Kubernetes, including reasoning about stateful vs stateless workloads and what that means for databases and persistent dataBuilding and integrating generative AI features that connect LLMs with the platform's enterprise data, APIs and internal tools - prompt design, tool calling, workflow orchestration, context management, guardrails and human reviewEvaluating AI workflows and monitoring quality, latency, cost, and failure ratesMaintaining a solid automated test suite (pytest) and helping build automated quality gatesUsing AI coding assistants effectively while validating all generated output before it reaches productionApplying security-first thinking at every layer, including tenant isolation, role-based access control, and least-privilege data access across UI, API, and AI workflowsParticipating in code reviews, identifying architectural and AI-reliability risks, and improving engineering practicesDocumenting data flows, API contracts and AI workflow behaviour clearly enough for non-engineers to act onDo we have a match?As an AI Engineer, you must meet the following criteria:6+ years of professional experience in software engineering with PythonExperience with FastAPI and Pydantic - endpoint design, dependency injection, models and validators, auth and error handlingSolid REST API design - versioning, predictable error semantics, token management, retries - with OAuth 2.0/Okta, JWT and role-based access control (RBAC)Experience with automated testing with pytestStrong SQL fundamentals (joins, GROUP BY, aggregate functions, query optimisation) and hands-on experience using PostgreSQL from Python - ORMs, database drivers, and a clear understanding of the trade-offs between synchronous and asynchronous driversSolid experience deploying and operating applications on KubernetesExperience with CI/CD pipelines (ideally GitHub Actions)Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs into production applications, including prompt design, tool/function calling, and safe handling of non-deterministic outputExperience using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar on a daily basisUnderstanding of multi-tenant SaaS application securityAbility to evaluate AI features and monitor quality, latency, cost, and reliabilityProduct mindset and ownership - you identify problems, propose solutions, and take features from idea to productionStrong communication skills and good knowledge of English (minimum C1 level)Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the following nice-to-haves:Evaluation and observability tooling for LLM features: eval harnesses, tracing, output scoring (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix or OpenTelemetry)Systematic prompt optimisation - versioned prompts, A/B tests, DSPyAgentic patterns beyond single LLM calls: multi-step orchestration, context management, guardrails and human-in-the-loopRetrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and vector search (pgvector, Pinecone), plus frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraphExperience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouseTemporal, Socket.IO / WebSockets, Redis, pub/subWorking knowledge of React / TypeScript — enough to make small front-end changes when a feature needs themMore reasons to join usFlexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybridProfessional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budgetSolid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy startA great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their workThe ability to change the project you work on

jobposting.description: As a Real-Time Data Service Specialist, you ensure the quality, availability, and transparency of real-time market data services by monitoring data feeds and coordinating the resolution of customer-impacting issues. Working closely with colleagues across time zones, you support our services 24/7 and collaborate with customers, data sources, and internal stakeholders. Operating at the intersection of data operations, customer support, and technical troubleshooting, you combine data expertise, analytical thinking, and technical understanding to manage time-critical incidents, assess customer impact, and drive service improvements. Acting as a central coordination point between customers, Customer Support, Product teams, and Service Reliability Engineers, you help deliver a reliable service experience and outstanding customer outcomes. What You Will DoPerform data monitoring and quality management for incoming data feeds from exchanges and contributors, including anomaly detection, validation, cleanup, and follow-up actions for existing and future sources.Act as the central coordination point for critical real-time incidents end-to-end, performing structured triage, customer impact assessment, stakeholder coordination, and transparent customer communication.Investigate and troubleshoot technical issues across market data delivery, APIs, network connectivity, and service operations, ensuring timely resolution and escalation.Provide operational expertise and technical consultancy by maintaining customer context, supporting onboarding activities, and collaborating across business and technology teams.Drive service reliability and continuous improvement through monitoring enhancements, release readiness, automation, recurring issue analysis, and operational excellence initiatives.24/5 shifts (7 hours) with colleagues in Warsaw and around the globe What You BringStrong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to understand complex data flows, system dependencies, and customer impact scenarios.Experience in production support, incident management, monitoring, or market data services, ideally within financial services or another business-critical environment.Good understanding of IT systems, APIs, networking, data processing, and troubleshooting techniques; scripting, SQL, or automation skills are an advantage. What We Offer Hybrid model up to 40% working from home Private Medical care and life insurance Meal, transportation and electricity allowance Sport cardCinema tickets, Benefit System pointsUp to 20 days working from abroad / Day for U Access to technical and language learning platforms

jobposting.description: WHO WE AREAccenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments, and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth, and enhance citizen services.At the AI&Data, we work locally and globally with over 200 Poland-based specialists. Our expertise spans data architecture and sectoral specialization. We collaborate with tech partners like Microsoft, AWS, Google, Oracle, and Snowflake to implement cutting-edge solutions. We provide comprehensive support from strategy definition to solution implementation and development, covering all aspects of Data & Analytics.THE WORKAs a Frontend Engineer – AI Solutions, you will design and build the user-facing layer of GenAI and agentic AI solutions for leading global enterprises. You’re the person who makes powerful AI systems usable – turning complex agent interactions, streaming LLM outputs, and enterprise data into intuitive, polished product experiences.We’re looking for someone who is React-strong, thinks in terms of user experience, and is excited about solving the unique UI/UX challenges that come with building AI-powered products. Understanding of frontend security best practices – including authentication and authorization flows, secure API integrations, and protection against common web vulnerabilities, is crucial on this position.You will:Build modern, responsive frontends for GenAI products using React and TypeScript – conversational interfaces, agent dashboards, data exploration tools, and interactive analytics viewsDesign and implement AI-specific interaction patterns: streaming chat, real-time agent status, citation rendering, confidence indicators, and graceful handling of AI uncertaintyOwn the UX quality of AI products – making deliberate decisions about information architecture, component design, accessibility, and how users interact with AI outputsIntegrate frontends with backend APIs, LLM services, and streaming endpoints – working closely with GenAI engineers to deliver seamless end-to-end experiencesCollaborate with engineers, designers, and consultants on cross-functional teams, shaping how enterprise users experience AIFlexible: The work location for this role may include a mix of working remotely (most of the time), onsite at a client or in an Accenture office – depending on specific project circumstances. With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?Build the interface layer of cutting-edge AI: you’ll shape how users actually experience GenAI – the part that makes the difference between a demo and a product.Solve UI/UX problems that barely exist yet: streaming agent interactions, multi-agent status views, conversational analytics – these design patterns are being invented right now, and you’ll be the one inventing them.Grow at the intersection of frontend engineering and AI: work alongside experienced AI & Data practitioners, gaining unique product engineering expertise that very few frontend developers have today.QualificationHERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEEDMin. 3 years of commercial experience in frontend developmentStrong proficiency in React and TypeScriptSolid understanding of modern frontend architecture – state management, component design, performance optimization, and responsive designExperience integrating frontends with REST APIs, WebSockets, or streaming endpointsStrong UX sensibility – ability to make deliberate design and interaction decisions, not just implement mockupsFamiliarity with AI-powered product interfaces (chatbots, conversational UIs, dashboards with AI-generated content) or a strong interest in this spaceProficiency with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, Copilot, or similar) – we expect these to be a core part of your daily workflow, not an occasional add-onGood command of English (min. B2+)BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVEExperience building real-time or streaming UIs (e.g., Server-Sent Events, WebSocket-based interfaces)Hands-on experience with UI component libraries and design systems (e.g., Shadcn, Radix, Material UI)Familiarity with Next.js or similar full-stack React frameworksBasic understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, or how GenAI APIs workExperience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Recharts, Visx)Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and inclusive design practicesExperience with frontend testing (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, React Testing Library)Basic backend or API development experience (Node.js, Python, FastAPI)Research indicates that some candidates, especially the most diverse ones, may hesitate to apply for positions if they don’t meet all requirements. If you believe you possess the necessary skills, even if not meeting every requirement, we wholeheartedly encourage you to submit your application.WHAT WE OFFER?A permanent employment contractIndividual support of a People Lead and a clearly defined path of professional development, including the possibility of a session with a CoachA comprehensive training package, including: soft skills, technical and language training, access to e-learning platforms, Gallup test, GenAI training, possibility of co-financing courses and certificationsEmployee Assistance Program offering legal, financial and psychological consultationsEmployee Share Purchase Plan – employees who own company shares are automatically eligible for quarterly dividendsPaid employee referral programPrivate medical care and life insuranceAccess to the Worksmile benefits platform (including the Multisport card)Interview Note: We value practical skills. During the technical interview, we’ll give you a real problem to solve and debug together – using your preferred development setup, including any AI-assisted tools you work with day to day.WHAT WE BELIEVE:Accenture does not discriminate employment candidates on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, national origin, political beliefs, trade union membership, ethnicity, denomination, sexual orientation or any other basis impermissible under Polish law. All our leaders are committed to building a better, stronger and more durable company for future generations to create positive, long-lasting change. Inclusion and diversity are fundamental to our culture and core values. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative and creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities. Our position as partner to many of the world’s leading businesses, organizations and governments affords us both an extraordinary opportunity and a tremendous responsibility to make a difference. Sustainability is one of our greatest responsibilities, which we embed it into everything we do and for everyone we work with. jobposting.description: About the RoleWe are looking for an experienced Release Train Engineer / Agile Delivery Program Lead to drive complex, multi-site software delivery initiatives. In this role, you will bridge technical execution with business strategy, steer multi-team Scaled Agile (SAFe) environments, manage cross-vendor dependencies, enforce rigorous compliance/validation standards, and ensure seamless handovers to operational teams.If you thrive in high-visibility environments, possess strong executive communication skills, and excel at leading cross-functional, distributed teams—we want to hear from you.Key Responsibilities & Qualifications1. Scaled Agile Delivery & SDLC GovernanceScaled Agile Mastery (SAFe / PI Planning): Hands-on experience facilitating Program Increment (PI) Planning cycles, managing technical and business objectives across multiple teams simultaneously.Dependency & Cross-Site Management: Ability to map and resolve complex dependencies across distributed teams (multi-site) and third-party vendors.End-to-End SDLC Oversight: Complete ownership of the software delivery lifecycle—from requirements gathering, development, and testing (Functional, UAT, Regression) to deployment cutover and post-go-live hypercare support.Risk & Impediment Management: Proactive tracking of blockers, quantitative risk assessments, mitigation planning, and structured escalation pathways.Governance & Delivery KPIs: Experience establishing operational frameworks (Ways of Working) and tracking key delivery metrics (e.g., Velocity, Lead Time, Defect Density, Milestone Variance).2. Multi-Site Leadership & Vendor ManagementDistributed Team Leadership: Proven ability to align cross-functional teams across multiple locations and time zones while maintaining consistent processes and high team engagement.Vendor & Contractor Management: Defining Statements of Work (SoWs), setting quality gates for external partners, and smoothly integrating contractor workflows into internal processes.Servant Leadership: Empowering Developers, Testers, TechOps, and Product Owners by removing operational friction, securing resources, and overseeing onboarding.RACI & Alignment: Defining clear Roles & Responsibilities across Business, Product, TechOps, and QA to streamline decision-making and eliminate boundary conflicts.3. Stakeholder Management & CommunicationExecutive-Level Reporting: Translating complex delivery status into clear, data-driven executive dashboards and concise reporting for C-level leadership.Negotiation & Prioritization: Partnering with Business Owners and Tech Product Owners to negotiate trade-offs between scope, timelines, and technical constraints.Change Management: Communicating project risks, delays, or scope shifts transparently, professionally, and with solution-oriented proposals.4. Compliance, Quality & Service TransitionRegulated / Validated Environment Experience: Practical knowledge of quality assurance standards and compliance requirements (e.g., GxP, ISO, healthcare regulations) where strict validation and documentation are mandatory prior to production release.TechOps Integration & Service Transition: Solid understanding of IT operations to ensure effective Handover to Operations (Service Transition) and post-release supportability.

jobposting.description: Job OverviewWe’re looking for a Senior Fullstack Developer to join our Product Department – the ~20-person crew behind SolDevelo’s apps for the Atlassian Marketplace and monday.com Marketplace. Think Worklogs, QAlity, and Checklists: tools relied on by everyone from small teams to huge, well-known corporations to run their Jira workflows. We build what our users actually ask for – closely listening to their feedback and shipping the features that matter to them, so what you build gets used, fast.You’ll join one of our two Scrum teams - comprising 3-4 developers, a tester, a product owner, and a UI/UX specialist - each owning a distinct set of products. This is a role for someone who wants to be the senior engineer our mid-level developers learn from: you’ll set the technical direction on the backend, maintain high code quality, and inspire those around you to raise their own bar. On the frontend, you’ll collaborate confidently; you don’t need to be a frontend authority, just capable of delivering features end-to-end.About SolDeveloSolDevelo has been building software for 15+ years. We’re an Atlassian Gold Marketplace Partner, ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certified, and have a team of around 60 people company-wide. In our Product Department, we keep things lean: small teams, direct customer feedback, and short paths from idea to production.Tech Stack & ToolsBackend: Java 17+, Spring Boot 3+Frontend: React 16+, TypeScript, Webpack, ESLintTesting: JUnit, Jest, React Testing Library, PlaywrightCI/CD: Bitbucket PipelinesAI tooling: Rovo Dev, Claude, GeminiMethodology: Agile / ScrumResponsibilitiesDesign and build features end-to-end – owning the backend architecture and contributing to the frontend alongside your team.Own backend code quality: set the standards, enforce them in reviews, and keep the codebase healthy over the long run.Be the mentor and technical leader for our mid-level developers – pair with them, coach them, and help them grow into seniors.Inspire the team by example: bring ideas, share what you learn, and set the tone for how we build.Contribute to architectural decisions with a focus on performance, security, and maintainability.Engage with design and product early, helping shape and influence business decisions before implementation even starts.Advocate for decisions that hold up at scale and stand the test of time, and speak up when they don’t.Help our service desk team dig into trickier customer-reported issues.Must-haveA minimum of five years of professional experience in software development.Senior-level, hands-on expertise in backend development with Java and Spring Boot.A proven track record designing and implementing backend architecture for web applications.Solid, mid-level working knowledge of React and TypeScript – enough to deliver production frontend features on your own.Commercial experience with unit testing on both backend and frontend.Proven ability to write performant, maintainable, and testable code.Demonstrated experience mentoring and leading mid-level developers – and genuine motivation to keep doing it.Solid tech debt management skills – identifying and prioritizing it; designing refactor plans.Strong knowledge of application security practices (e.g. OWASP Top 10) and the ability to define, implement, and monitor a security strategy in collaboration with DevOps and QA.Ability to estimate complex projects end-to-end, coordinate the estimation process for the team, and account for uncertainty and risk in requirements.Comfortable working async with a distributed team.Excellent command of Polish (C1 or higher).Excellent command of English (C1 or higher).Nice-to-haveFamiliarity with the Atlassian ecosystem or background in building on Atlassian Forge, Connect, or another third-party app platform (Shopify, Salesforce, etc.).Experience running knowledge-sharing formats – internal talks, tech guilds, onboarding programs.Good UI taste with attention to detail – comfortable pushing back on proposed designs and offering alternatives.Exposure to AI and agentic workflows.BenefitsFully remote work – we don’t do “remote but come to the office on Tuesdays”.Flexible working hours, with core hours 10 AM – 3 PM (CEST).12,000 PLN yearly budget for certificates and training.Dedicated time set aside each month for learning, on top of the training budget.Company and team integration events.MultiSport card.Amazon Kindle and 150 PLN quarterly for e-books.150 PLN quarterly for cultural & sports activities.Private medical care.Recruitment ProcessInitial Application: Submit your application through our online form.Screening: Our recruitment team will review your application to ensure you meet the basic requirements.Telephone Interview: A preliminary conversation to discuss your experience and suitability for the position.Preliminary Acceptance: If successful, you will move forward to the technical verification stage.Technical Verification (1-2h): An in-depth assessment of your technical skills and knowledge.Offer: If successful, you will receive a formal job offer.

jobposting.description: About the job Our team drives the solutions that build a modern, secure, and resilient workplace ecosystem for Allegro employees across the whole Group. As a collaborative team of Systems Engineers and Systems Administrators, we develop the digital workplace environment, powering services such as endpoint management, printing, CCTV, corporate password manager, and many more. We oversee the management, security, and health of all endpoint devices such as macOS/Windows workstations, iOS/Android mobile devices. Our scope also covers infrastructure and internal process automation using modern scripting, managing secure remote access, and scaling our virtual workplace infrastructure. We are also constantly exploring emerging technologies, including AI capabilities, to build smarter services. We work in close collaboration with both highly technical and business teams across the organization, participating in various projects from requirements and system design to final implementation. Our ultimate goal is to create a seamless, best-in-class digital workplace environment that empowers our employees and drives Allegro's growth. Important things for you Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.Our team is mostly based in Poznan. What will your job involve? Owning and managing complex IT infrastructure services.Designing macro-level architecture and blueprints for new systems, focusing on how different technologies integrate flawlessly, scale, and remain highly available.Managing the full lifecycle of features and services, from initial requirement elicitation and analysis to final system deployment.Designing, implementing, and optimizing proactive monitoring and alerting systems to stay ahead of potential infrastructure anomalies.Automating troubleshooting processes and performing complex root cause analysis on distributed, large-scale systems.Leading and executing key IT infrastructure migration, upgrade, and modernization projects across international environments.Preparing, expanding, and maintaining clear technical documentation, procedures, and task tracking for complex systemsCollaborating closely with specialized domain teams across the organization, such as corporate network, security, and IT support.Participating in a 24h on-duty rotation scheme - remaining available via phone and computer to resolve critical service issues outside of core working hours. You’ll be a great fit if you bring Expert-level knowledge of managing large-scale endpoint environments.Extensive experience with cloud platforms, Windows Server RDS services, and modern virtualization/container platforms (Docker).Strong proficiency in writing scripts (PowerShell /  Bash / Python) with a continuous drive toward automation, optimization, and AI-assisted operations.Deep skills in privilege management, building security rules, managing permission sets, and establishing endpoint compliance.The ability to transition smoothly from day-to-day operations to an engineering and systems-thinking mindset, mapping out the 'big picture'.Strong time management and project management skills, with the capability to autonomously lead projects and seamlessly cooperate with technical and business stakeholders.Great teamwork abilities, minimum B2 English communication skills, and an orientation toward building long-term, supportive business relationships with internal clients and vendors.A degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional training combined with proven experience in a similar position.Proactivity and a readiness for occasional business trips to work face-to-face with specialized teams across different company locations.A strong orientation toward building long-term relationships with external vendors and effectively navigating stakeholders from both technical and business branchesAnalytical thinking skills, proactivity, and a strong drive to identify recurring issues and implement long-term fixes rather than just temporary patchesWhat's in it for you: Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).A 16' or 14' MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories.A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings. An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal. Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy. And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here. #goodtobehere means that: You will join a team you can count on - we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA.You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.You will value our Developer Experience and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Na czym będzie polegać Twoja rola: Weźmiesz pod opiekę produkt odpowiadający za zarządzanie codziennymi operacjami wykonywanymi przez franczyzobiorców Będziesz współpracować z Product Managerem - on zadba o strategię i kierunek rozwoju, Ty skupisz się na skutecznym przekładaniu ich na działania zespołów.Przełożysz strategię i cele produktu na konkretne potrzeby biznesowe i problemy użytkowników, a następnie zdekomponujesz je na zadania w Backlogu produktu.Będziesz częścią zarówno zespołu discovery, jak i delivery - biorąc udział w testowaniu pomysłów i walidowaniu hipotez, równolegle z wdrażaniem gotowych, wartościowych funkcji. Twoim celem będzie dostarczanie realnej wartości użytkownikowi końcowemu.Będziesz współpracować z Product Ownerami i Product Managerami innych produktów franczyzowych - dbając o spójność doświadczenia użytkownika i wymieniając się wiedzą oraz inspiracjami.  Kogo szukamy: Masz minimum 3 lata doświadczenia w roli Product Ownera/Product Ownerki - najlepiej w firmie z branży retail, e-commerce lub operacji/logistyki.Pracowałaś/pracowałeś nad złożonymi produktami - z wieloma procesami biznesowymi, integracjami i różnorodnymi grupami użytkowników.Masz praktyczne doświadczenie w pracy w zespole scrumowym - znasz rytm i zasady Agile, potrafisz efektywnie prowadzić backlog i koordynować pracę zespołu.Podejmujesz decyzje w oparciu o dane, nie opinie - potrafisz analizować informacje, wyciągać wnioski i wykorzystywać je do podejmowania trafnych decyzji.Umiesz współpracować z zespołami o różnych kompetencjach - developerskimi, designerskimi, analitycznymi - łącząc ich perspektywy w jednym kierunku.Potrafisz jasno się komunikować, angażować innych, zbierać, porządkować i priorytetyzować potrzeby oraz budować wspólne zrozumienie kierunku działań.Jesteś samodzielna/samodzielny, kreatywna/kreatywny i gotowa/gotowy do przejęcia odpowiedzialności za produkt. jobposting.description: Hey! Nice to see you! At Incubly, we believe that great people want to work with great people, so we started to build a company that attracts great minds and enables us to achieve great things while genuinely enjoying what we do. Our mission is to support tech companies and startups (scaleups) in scaling their teams quickly and with high quality, while boosting product development, testing, and deployment so we can succeed together.We are currently working with a French company that leads in security and infrastructure solutions for cryptocurrencies and blockchain applications. It has a team of more than 400 professionals developing a variety of products and services to safeguard cryptocurrency assets, including world-leading hardware wallets.As a Platform Engineer, you will work closely with product engineering teams to improve the developer experience and remove friction from the build, package, and deployment process. You will own and improve developer tooling, self-service platforms, golden paths, runners, registries, delivery tooling, and observability. You will collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure the platform is fast, reliable, secure, and easy to use, while using automation and strong systems thinking to help teams ship faster and more safely.Your daily responsibilitiesCI/CD platform & runner fleet Own and evolve the self-hosted GitHub Actions runner fleet, including Linux runners managed via Actions Runner Controller (ARC), self-hosted macOS runners, and the Terraform modules that provision and scale self-hosted infrastructure. Right-size runner classes (CPU/memory/storage) against real workload profiles, balancing cost efficiency against engineering velocity, and supporting engineering teams in understanding and owning the resource footprint of their own jobs. Support the migration away from GitHub-hosted runners, including evaluating trade-offs between containerised and VM-based execution for workloads with special hardware requirements (e.g. KVM access for Android emulators). Partner with embedded DevOps engineers on pipeline and dependency-graph optimisations (build triggers, job fan-out, monorepo change detection) to reduce queue times and unnecessary CI spend — you own the platform and runner layer these pipelines execute on. Investigate and resolve macOS virtualisation performance issues (e.g. Tart) and help evaluate alternative approaches such as remote simulator hosts. Artifact & package management Administer the JFrog Platform (Artifactory, Xray, Curation) as the organization’s primary artifactrepository, including repository structure, access control, vulnerability scanning policies, and curation/allow-listing of upstream dependencies. Provide light-touch, minimal support for GitHub Container Registry (GHCR) and GitHub Packages where teams use them alongside JFrog. Operate and maintain ChartMuseum as the organization’s Helm chart repository, hosted on S3,including storage lifecycle, access, and chart promotion workflows.Define and enforce container image ownership boundaries — platform-owned hardened/minimal base images (e.g. Docker Hardened Images, Chainguard) versus engineering-owned project extensions — and drive Dockerfile build and layer optimisation best practices across teams. Progressive delivery & infrastructure automation Operate two ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts environments, one serving internal tooling and one serving product workloads supporting GitOps-based, progressive delivery (canary/blue-green) patterns for engineering teams.Author, maintain, and support Helm charts and Kustomize overlays as the standard configuration management approach for Kubernetes workloads, providing golden-path templates that reduce boilerplate for product teams.Design, review, and evolve Terraform and Terragrunt modules for infrastructure-as-code, including maintaining a public/internal module registry that product and platform teams can consume in a self-service manner. Observability & reliability Improve and help unify the observability stack; Grafana, Prometheus, and Alertmanager. Fixing metric accuracy issues, building meaningful dashboards, and defining SLOs/alerting that reflect real platform and pipeline health.Work across Datadog and VictoriaLogs/VictoriaMetrics to reduce tool sprawl, and help define a coherent strategy for where metrics, logs, and events should live.Provide platform-level telemetry (runner utilization, build queue times, artifact scan results, deployment health) that gives engineering teams and leadership a single, trustworthy view of pipeline and platform performance. Internal developer platform, policy & modern workloads Evaluate and help operate Crossplane as a control-plane layer for self-service, Kubernetes-native infrastructure provisioning, complementing the existing Terraform/Terragrunt IaC estate.Contribute to a developer portal / internal catalogue strategy (e.g. Backstage, Cortex, or Port) so engineers have a single place to discover services, ownership, docs, and golden-path templates.Implement and maintain policy-as-code guardrails using Kyverno and/or Open Policy Agent (OPA) across the Kubernetes and CI/CD estate (e.g. image provenance, resource limits, security baselines).Support Knative-based serverless/event-driven workloads on Kubernetes where teams need scale-to-zero or request-driven compute.Roll out OpenTelemetry instrumentation and pipelines to standardise traces, metrics, and logs across services, feeding the Grafana/Prometheus/Datadog/VictoriaLogs stack with consistent, correlated telemetry. Developer experience & enablement Act as the platform’s embedded point of contact for one or more product engineering teams: Understand their day-to-day friction, prioritise platform work accordingly, and close the loop on delivery.Build self-service tooling, templates, and documentation (golden paths) so engineers can provision runners, publish artifacts, and deploy without needing deep platform expertise.Clearly document ownership boundaries between platform and product teams (e.g. base images vs. application extensions) and help engineering teams operate confidently within them.Contribute to the platform roadmap, bringing a developer-experience lens to prioritisation — and measure success in terms of engineer-facing outcomes such as build time, queue time, and self-service adoption, not just infrastructure uptime.We need you to haveExperience & technical skills 5+ years in a Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering role, ideally supporting product engineering teams directly.Hands-on experience with GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runner architectures (Actions Runner Controller / Kubernetes-based Linux runners, self-hosted macOS runners) and provisioning them via Terraform.Practical knowledge of the JFrog Platform (Artifactory, Xray, and ideally Curation) for artifact management and dependency security.Familiarity with container registries beyond a single vendor (GHCR/GitHub Packages) and Helm chart repositories such as ChartMuseum on object storage (S3).Experience with GitOps continuous delivery using ArgoCD, and ideally Argo Rollouts for progressive delivery (canary/blue-green) across multiple clusters/environments.Strong Kubernetes configuration management skills with Helm and Kustomize.Solid Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform and Terragrunt, including designing and consuming shared/reusable modules.Experience with Crossplane (or a comparable Kubernetes-native control-plane approach) for building self-service infrastructure APIs, alongside deep Terraform proficiency for the underlying IaC.Experience building or operating an internal developer portal/software catalogue such as Backstage, Cortex, or Port, including modelling service ownership and scorecards.Hands-on experience with policy-as-code enforcement in Kubernetes using Kyverno and/or Open Policy Agent (OPA / Gatekeeper) — e.g. image provenance, resource limits, security baselines.Familiarity with Knative or similar Kubernetes-native serverless/eventing frameworks for scale-to-zero or request-driven workloads.Experience building, hardening, and optimizing container images (Dockerfile best practices, minimal/hardened base images such as Docker Hardened Images or Chainguard).Working knowledge of an observability stack — Grafana, Prometheus, and Alertmanager — plus exposure to Datadog and/or VictoriaLogs/VictoriaMetrics, and practical experience instrumenting services and pipelines with OpenTelemetry (traces, metrics, logs).Comfortable in Linux/Unix environments, with solid scripting ability (e.g. Bash, Python, or Go) and strong Git fundamentals.AWS cloud experience (compute, storage/S3, networking fundamentals) is a plus. Soft skills Genuine product mindset toward internal platforms: you think in terms of the engineer as a customer, and you seek out and act on their feedback.Strong cross-functional collaborator, comfortable embedding with a product engineering team and building trust with people who don’t share your infrastructure background.Clear written and verbal communicator, able to explain infrastructure concepts (e.g. Kubernetes, runner sizing, build performance) to engineers without a platform background, and able to tailor the level of detail to the audience.Pragmatic and cost-conscious: able to balance reliability, security, developer speed, and infrastructure cost, and to make and explain trade-offs rather than defaulting to “more resources.” Ownership mindset with strong personal accountability; comfortable working autonomously and driving initiatives from discovery through to rollout.Curious and continuously improving: proactively investigates root causes (e.g. inconsistent metrics, flaky runners) rather than just resolving symptoms.Comfortable with ambiguity and evolving priorities, and able to sequence and negotiate scope in a fast-moving, PI-based planning environment.Empathetic and collaborative when defining ownership boundaries between platform and product teams, favouring clarity and shared documentation over friction. Would be great if you haveExperience supporting mobile/device-testing CI (e.g. Android emulator/KVM requirements, iOS simulators) in a self-hosted runner context.Experience with developing platform API and CLI for developers to consume blueprints and patterns using either Kratix or Crossplane tooling.Experience with large Kubernetes cluster fleet automation from provisioning to upgrade to decommission Experience operating in a large monorepo, including build-graph/dependency-aware CI triggering.Prior experience defining or operating SLOs/SLAs and error budgets for internal platform services. jobposting.description: What you work on today shapes where you’ll be tomorrow.Looking for your next challenge as a Fullstack Engineer? We may have the right opportunity for you.At B3, we start with people and their experience. We match projects to your skills and professional growth path. Our consultants work across a wide range of industries and technologies, delivering IT projects both in Poland and internationally. This allows you to build your career in a deliberate way - not by chance.We are part of an international organization listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, operating in 11 countries. In Poland, we operate with full autonomy. We choose our technologies, processes, and ways of working while maintaining the highest professional standards.Join us today.Key areas of the role:Backend and APIs - Preparing mocks, designing and adjusting APIs in Java/Kotlin within a microservices architecture, enabling integrations with external strategic partnersFrontend in React - Building responsive web components, checkout funnels and registration paths, and integrating the frontend with the backend and the mobile appBuilding new services - Working on services that run outside the core market but are integrated with platform services (payments, login, search), delivering fast with the support of AI and agentic development toolsYour responsibilities:Designing and adjusting backend APIs and preparing backend mocks using Java or Kotlin within a microservices architecture.Developing responsive web components, checkout funnels, and registration pathways using React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.Integrating systems and endpoints to facilitate onboarding and seamless collaboration with strategic external partners.Switching context dynamically between backend enablement and web frontend development depending on project priorities.Leveraging AI coding tools and agentic development workflows to accelerate product delivery and streamline full-stack tasks.Requirements:5+ years of experience in Java or Kotlin and comfortable working with microservices architecture.Hands-on frontend experience using React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.Understanding of REST API principles, JSON data manipulation, and consuming backend endpoints.Openness to utilizing AI tools and LLMs in daily development and code generation workflows.Proficiency in English at a minimum B2+ level.Must reside in and/or have work authorization in Poland.What we offerWork in a Scandinavian culture built on logic, trust, and open dialogue.Health and sports benefits tailored to your needs.Speed Coaching – short sessions designed to provide new perspectives and solutions.Sports training, an internal team, and opportunities to take part in competitions.

jobposting.description: What you will be part of: The Financial Data Application (FDA) team within the Group IT Division, Data & AI is responsible for the central, group-wide finance data hub, calculation engines and posting platform of Helvetia. We run and continuously develop four core SAS-based applications:CDS (Common Data Store): A central finance data hub that consolidates, validates, and stores all relevant finance data from market units. It distributes this data to calculation engines and BAT, while also receiving and managing the calculated results.BAT (Baloise Accounting Transactions): A group-wide posting engine that generates accounting documents for SAP based on validated input from local units and calculation engines, and posts them directly into SAP.RIVA9: A solution that calculates IFRS 9 Expected Credit Losses (ECL) based on validated data from CDS, and returns the results to the respective source systems.SOLE (Solvency Processing Engine): A system that determines how assets should be assigned to accounts and in what amounts within the Extended Ledger for Solvency. It then generates transaction records, which are posted into SAP via BAT.Role Purpose: We are looking for an experienced SAS Developer to take a key role in maintaining and evolving critical solutions such as BAT, RIVA9, CDS, and SOLE.This position offers a unique opportunity to step into a well-established environment and working closely with long-standing experts to ensure a smooth and effective knowledge transfer, while quickly becoming a driving force behind upcoming transformations. You will contribute to both the stability and future development of these services, supporting daily operations while also leading improvements, including the redesign of SAP interfaces and enhancing system performance and scalability to meet growing data demands. The role combines hands-on development with impactful optimization work, making it ideal for someone who enjoys both maintaining reliable systems and shaping their future evolution in a dynamic environment.Key Responsibilities:Maintain, operate and further develop the BAT posting engine and the RIVA9 IFRS 9 calculation engine (SAS 9.4).Implement Transaction Record version upgrades. New data fields, format changes, segment derivation from CDS master data.Design and build a new interface from SAS into SAP.Improve performance and further parallelize processing in line with increased data volumes.Act as the bridge between Business Analysts / accounting business teams and technical implementation in an agile setup.Take real ownership, proactively, precisely and reliably ensure that this business-critical service does not “stand still”.Your Skills:At least 3 years of professional experience in SAS implementation, ideally on financial data / accounting platforms.Expert in SAS 9.4: SAS Foundation, SAS Macro Language, SAS DI Studio, SAS Enterprise Guide, SAS Studio.Solid SQL and database experience (DB2, Oracle).Experience with web services and XML structures (also JSON, REST/SOAP).Experience with Python and Databricks. Strong analytical mindset and ability to take end-to-end ownership of a service.Very good English, German is a plus.Ideally, you also have: SAS Platform Architecture (Metadata Server, Management Console).Experience with SAP Accounting platforms (SAP FI, S/4HANA GL).Familiarity with version control (Git / Subversion), Jira, Confluence.Background in agile / Scrum software development, reviews and test strategies.This role will be a great fit for someone who enjoys taking ownership and making things happen in practice, not just in theory. You will likely feel at home here if you are comfortable acting as a bridge between business and IT, translating technical topics into clear and meaningful insights. We are looking for someone who is naturally curious, solution-oriented and analytical, with a strong sense of empathy when working with others. This role will suit someone who thrives in an agile, evolving environment and enjoys taking responsibility while contributing to real, impactful outcomes.What you can expect from us:We want to provide you with everything you need to succeed. To do that, we offer a bunch of benefits (depending on the type of contract chosen).Paid time off: Enjoy 30 paid days off per year.Flexible benefits budget: Additional budget that can be used for both personal or professional development.Comprehensive medical coverage: Full private healthcare for you and your family, including rehabilitation, psychotherapy, and dental services.Home office allowance: Support for a comfortable and productive remote work setup.Work from anywhere in Poland: Freedom to work remotely with the option to access our modern office in central Warsaw. You could expect occasional travels to Switzerland.Recruitment Process Overview:45min video call with our recruiter.1h Technical Video Call.1h video call with Project Lead.Join us in shaping the future of insurance at Helvetia Baloise Group where in a dynamic, global team setting, you’ll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life and work alongside experts to solve demanding technical challenges.

jobposting.description: Cześć! Tu Axence. Mówią o nas, że jesteśmy zespołem niezwykle utalentowanych i zaangażowanych ludzi, którzy na co dzień kształtują przyszłość bezpieczeństwa IT. Stawiamy na sprawczość, elastyczność i kreatywność – działamy bez korporacyjnych opóźnień i zbędnej biurokracji. Dostarczamy rozwiązania dla działów IT, zarówno w Polsce, jak i na świecie. Dołączysz do istniejącego zespołu QA i będziesz na co dzień współpracować z innymi specjalistami odpowiedzialnymi za zapewnienie jakości naszych rozwiązań - z Product Ownerami, Project Managerami, analitykami biznesowymi oraz programistami. Jakie będą Twoje obowiązki? Udział w pełnym cyklu wytwarzania oprogramowania - od analizy wymagań biznesowych i technicznych, przez testy, aż po wdrożenie i utrzymanie produktu.Analiza, zbieranie i doprecyzowywanie wymagań biznesowych oraz technicznych.Ścisła współpraca z Product Ownerami, Project Managerami, analitykami biznesowymi oraz programistami w celu zapewnienia wysokiej jakości dostarczanych biznesowego.Wykonywanie testów funkcjonalnych, regresyjnych, eksploracyjnych, akceptacyjnych oraz niefunkcjonalnych.Testowanie API oraz weryfikacja danych niezbędnych do realizacji procesów testowych.Raportowanie, analiza i weryfikacja zgłoszonych defektów.Zarządzanie cyklem życia błędów oraz wspieranie procesu ich priorytetyzacji z biznesem i Product Ownerami.Analiza wpływu zmian na istniejące funkcjonalności oraz procesy biznesowe.Szacowanie zakresu testów oraz nakładu pracy potrzebnego do weryfikacji nowych funkcjonalności.Współtworzenie strategii testów dla nowych funkcjonalności i projektów.Tworzenie raportów z testów oraz rekomendacji dotyczących jakości produktu i gotowości do wydania.Prowadzenie Root Cause Analysis po krytycznych defektach lub incydentach produkcyjnych.Proponowanie i wdrażanie usprawnień procesu testowego.Współtworzenie standardów testowych oraz definicji jakości w zespole.Wspieranie rozwoju mniej doświadczonych testerów poprzez konsultacje, dzielenie się wiedzą i mentoring.Wsparcie zespołu wsparcia technicznego przy analizie i rozwiązywaniu zgłoszeń klientów.Aplikuj do nas, jeżeli: Masz minimum 5 lat komercyjnego doświadczenia w testowaniu oprogramowania.Możesz się pochwalić dobrą znajomością metodyk, procesów oraz technik testowania oprogramowania.Posiadasz doświadczenie w analizie wymagań biznesowych i funkcjonalnych oraz identyfikowaniu związanych z nimi ryzyk.Potrafisz projektować scenariusze i przypadki testowe z uwzględnieniem ryzyka biznesowego.Masz doświadczenie w planowaniu zakresu testów oraz priorytetyzacji działań testowych.Swobodnie przeprowadzasz testy manualne, eksploracyjne, regresyjne, akceptacyjne oraz niefunkcjonalne.Masz doświadczenie w testowaniu API z wykorzystaniem narzędzi takich jak Postman lub Swagger.Znasz SQL, co pozwala Ci na analizę i weryfikację danych testowych.Potrafisz diagnozować oraz precyzyjnie raportować błędy.Jesteś samodzielny(-a) i masz bardzo jobposting.description: UX design for complex design tooling, at the intersection of design and engineering. This is a UX design role inside Qt's Design Tools Unit (DTU). The tools serve designers and developers building production Qt applications — people with deep domain knowledge who form opinions about tools quickly and expect them to be well-considered at every level.We are hiring at two levels: Regular and Senior. Both work the same products alongside the same engineering teams; what differs is scope of ownership and the level at which each contributes to product direction.DTU works deeply with engineering. Design that can't be built costs everyone time. UX designers here — at either level — understand implementation constraints, propose solutions that work within them, and stay close to the build. This is genuine collaboration with engineers, not handoff.Requirements:Regular UX DesignerTwo or more years of UX design experience, with a portfolio showing solid work across flows, wireframes, and interaction design.Comfortable in Figma.Able to collaborate with engineers through implementation and communicate design decisions clearly to people who weren't in the room when they were made.Some exposure to design or development tooling is a genuine advantage — DTU's product users are design professionals themselves, so the UX is always under scrutiny.Senior UX DesignerFive or more years of UX design, with a portfolio demonstrating ownership of complex product surfaces, not just individual features.Able to hold a design problem from research through delivery and articulate the reasoning behind decisions at every stage.Figma to professional standard.Real understanding of the designer–developer workflow.DTU's products live at that boundary and the person in this role needs to understand both sides.Comfortable designing for technically sophisticated users.Experience in design tooling, developer tools, or B2B software is a strong advantage.A background on larger product teams — where decisions in one area created real dependencies in others — is directly relevant.Main responsibilities:Interaction and flow design.User flows, wireframes, and interaction patterns for product surfaces. Both the core feature design and the detailed interaction states between them. The goal is designed behaviour that is obvious to the people using it, even when the problem it solves is not.Prototyping and validation.Prototyping flows to test assumptions before committing them to engineering. Bringing user feedback in early enough that it can still change direction, not after the build is already done.Engineer collaboration.Working alongside engineering through the full development cycle. Communicating design intent clearly, answering questions that come up during build, and staying close enough to delivery that the design doesn't drift in ways that matter.Design system.Using DTU's shared design system correctly. Raising gaps to the system maintainer rather than solving them in isolation.UX and visual design boundary.DTU has distinct UX and visual design roles working the same product surfaces. Being clear on what UX owns and where visual design takes over — and collaborating across that boundary cleanly — is part of what makes the work here function well.What the senior track adds:Product surface ownershipEnd-to-end UX responsibility for a product surface or major feature area — from problem definition through shipped product. Not treating delivery as the finish line, but staying close enough to see how it lands with real users.Product strategy contribution.A point of view on product direction: which are the right problems, what trade-offs are worth making, where the team might be undervaluing something. Senior designers here are expected to push back on scope and shape what gets prioritised.Research as design input.Planning and running user research to validate direction early. Synthesising findings into decisions, not just reports. At Senior level, research is a design input, not a separate workstream — it informs what gets designed and why.Design system contribution.Not just applying the system, but contributing to it: flagging where interaction patterns need library support, and working with the system maintainer to address gaps through process rather than workarounds.Systemic thinking.Spotting dependencies between product areas early, before they create problems. Bringing the right people into conversations before decisions lock. Experience from larger product teams, where cross-area collaboration was unavoidable, maps directly to what this level of the role requires.

jobposting.description: About Sollers Consulting:Sollers Consulting is more than a consultancy and software integrator. As a company founded in 2000, our mission has been to transform the financial & insurance industries by helping them adapt to new technologies.  The power of collaboration and the limitless potential of Sollers people are at the root of our success. We strive to be the best at what we do, both in the eyes of our team and our customers. We put people at the heart of every project. Join us and make Sollers be driven by… you! About Salesforce Competency at Sollers:Versatility is the keyword when it comes to what we do in IT. Development is just the beginning of a long journey where we get familiar with business, processes, and architecture. But at the end of the day, the result is always the same: a ready-to-use solution used by everyone around us. As a Sollers developer working within our Salesforce Competence, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously expand your skill set, navigate complex challenges, and contribute to the creation of solutions that empower businesses and individuals alike. You will also be able to broaden your skillset with other cloud-based platforms if you want to.About the role. You will:Design and build solutions on Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Financial Services Cloud (FSC), leveraging Salesforce Industries / OmniStudio tools (FlexCards, OmniScripts, Integration Procedures, DataRaptors) for insurance clients.Lead the design of IT solutions, taking into account the architecture and its constraints.Serve as a reliable advisor and “sparring partner” for our clients.Independently lead a project team, ensuring the timely completion of tasks and maintaining high standards.Conduct active, regular code reviews and help establish and enforce coding standards across the team.Monitor compliance with project scope, spread good practices, and share knowledge across teams.Create well-structured technical documentation (e.g., using BPMN, UML).Work directly with our clients as an active member of an agile project team.Build strong and long-lasting relationships with clients, spotting opportunities to expand our engagement where relevant.About the requirements. You need:At least 4 years of commercial experience as a Salesforce Developer.A minimum of 1 year of experience in a leadership role, such as a Tech Lead or Architect.Hands-on experience with Apex (Triggers, Batch, Async Apex) and Lightning Web Components (LWC).Experience with REST/SOAP web services integrations.Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), design patterns, and clean code principles.Fluency in English (at least B2/C1 level) is a must.Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to bridge business requirements with technical solutions and effectively facilitate workshops.Experience in estimating effort on various levels and identifying potential risks.Readiness to travel (we work partially from the client side).Ability to work in the European Union. About the wishes. Nice to haves:Familiarity with OmniStudio components (FlexCards, OmniScripts, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures) — or strong readiness to ramp up quickly on top of a solid Apex/LWC foundation.Salesforce certifications (e.g., Platform Developer I/II, OmniStudio Developer/Consultant, Application/System Architect).Experience from a consulting company or financial services.A proactive approach to self-development. About our promises. We can offer:Flexible working hours and remote work at the beginning of cooperation. After we open an office/coworking space, a hybrid home-office model (2-3 times per week in the office), as work-life balance is crucial at Sollers.A chance to be promoted twice a year and a clearly defined career path with salary forecast. Opportunities for growth with a training budget that you can use for courses and conferences. We also provide access to an online training platform and co-fund language classes. An internal coach to guide you through the onboarding, further training and career opportunities, plus a budget to be used for your lunches together. A chance to #domore for the planet and the community as part of Sollers Change Makers – our volunteering program. Lots of teambuilding activities, trips, hobby groups and cultural events to create a company powered by teamwork. Probably all the benefits you can think of!

Jakie będą Twoje obowiązki? Udział w pełnym cyklu wytwarzania oprogramowania - od analizy wymagań biznesowych i technicznych, przez testy, aż po wdrożenie i utrzymanie produktu.Analiza, zbieranie i doprecyzowywanie wymagań biznesowych oraz technicznych.Ścisła współpraca z Product Ownerami, Project Managerami, analitykami biznesowymi oraz programistami w celu zapewnienia wysokiej jakości dostarczanych rozwiązań.Odpowiedzialność za wybrane obszary produktu lub domeny biznesowe (end-to-end ownership).Projektowanie scenariuszy i przypadków testowych z uwzględnieniem ryzyka oraz wpływu biznesowego.Wykonywanie testów funkcjonalnych, regresyjnych, eksploracyjnych, akceptacyjnych oraz niefunkcjonalnych.Testowanie API oraz weryfikacja danych niezbędnych do realizacji procesów testowych.Raportowanie, analiza i weryfikacja zgłoszonych defektów.Zarządzanie cyklem życia błędów oraz wspieranie procesu ich priorytetyzacji z biznesem i Product Ownerami.Analiza wpływu zmian na istniejące funkcjonalności oraz procesy biznesowe.Szacowanie zakresu testów oraz nakładu pracy potrzebnego do weryfikacji nowych funkcjonalności.Współtworzenie strategii testów dla nowych funkcjonalności i projektów.Tworzenie raportów z testów oraz rekomendacji dotyczących jakości produktu i gotowości do wydania.Prowadzenie Root Cause Analysis po krytycznych defektach lub incydentach produkcyjnych.Proponowanie i wdrażanie usprawnień procesu testowego.Współtworzenie standardów testowych oraz definicji jakości w zespole.Wspieranie rozwoju mniej doświadczonych testerów poprzez konsultacje, dzielenie się wiedzą i mentoring.Wsparcie zespołu wsparcia technicznego przy analizie i rozwiązywaniu zgłoszeń klientów.Aplikuj do nas, jeżeli: Masz minimum 5 lat komercyjnego oraz priorytetyzacji działań testowych.Swobodnie przeprowadzasz testy manualne, eksploracyjne, regresyjne, akceptacyjne oraz niefunkcjonalne.Masz doświadczenie w testowaniu API z wykorzystaniem narzędzi takich jak Postman lub Swagger.Znasz SQL, co pozwala Ci na analizę i weryfikację danych testowych.Potrafisz diagnozować oraz precyzyjnie raportować błędy.Jesteś samodzielny(-a) i masz bardzo
